1
高宗法天隆運至誠先覺體元立極敷文奮武欽明孝慈神聖純皇帝，諱弘曆，世宗第四子，母孝聖憲皇后，康熙五十年八月十三日生於雍親王府邸。 隆準頎身，聖祖見而鍾愛，令讀書宮中，受學於庶吉士福敏，過目成誦。 復學射於貝勒允禧，學火器於莊親王允祿。 木蘭從獮，命侍衛引射熊。 甫上馬，熊突起。 上控轡自若。 聖祖御槍殪熊。 入武帳，顧語溫惠皇太妃曰：「是命貴重，福將過予。 」
Emperor Gaozong (Qianlong), temple name Hongli, was Yongzheng's fourth son, born at Prince Yong's mansion in Kangxi 50. Kangxi favored the tall, imposing boy and had him study in the palace under Fu Min, who found him memorized lessons at a glance. He trained in archery with Yunxi and in firearms with Prince Zhuang Yunlu. During a mulan hunt, guards were told to guide him to shoot a bear. He had barely mounted when the bear charged. Hongli kept his seat and did not flinch. Kangxi fired and brought the bear down. In the tent Kangxi told Imperial Noble Consort Wen Hui that the boy's destiny was august and his blessings would exceed his own. The remark ended there.
2
雍正元年八月，世宗御乾清宮，密書上名，緘藏世祖所書正大光明扁額上。 五年，娶孝賢皇后富察氏。 十一年，封和碩寶親王。 時準噶爾役未竟，又有黔苗兵事，命上綜理軍機，諮決大計。
In Yongzheng 1, month 8, Yongzheng sealed Hongli's name in the casket behind the "Upright and Illuminating" plaque. In year 5 he wed Empress Xiaoxian (Fu). In year 11 he became Prince Bao. With Dzungar and Guizhou Miao wars still raging, Yongzheng put him in charge of Grand Council strategy.
3
十三年八月丁亥，世宗不豫。 時駐蹕圓明園，上與和親王弘晝朝夕謹侍。 戊子，世宗疾大漸，召莊親王允祿，果親王允禮，大學士鄂爾泰、張廷玉，領侍衛內大臣豐盛額、訥親，內大臣戶部侍郎海望入受顧命。 己丑，崩。 王大臣請奉大行皇帝還宮。 莊親王允祿等啟雍正元年立皇太子密封，宣詔即皇帝位。 尋諭奉大行皇帝遺命，莊親王允祿、果親王允禮、鄂爾泰、張廷玉輔政，並令鄂爾泰復任，以鄂爾泰因病請假也。 以遺命尊奉妃母為皇太后，復奉懿旨以上元妃為皇后。 召大學士朱軾回京。 命大學士嵇曾筠總理浙江海塘工，趙弘恩署江南河道總督。 大行皇帝大殮，命以乾清宮南廡為倚廬。 庚寅，命總理事務王大臣議行三年喪。 命履郡王允祹暫管禮部事務。 召張照回京，以張廣泗總理苗疆事務，大學士邁柱署湖廣總督。 諭大將軍查郎阿駐肅州，與劉於義同掌軍務，北路大將軍平郡王福彭堅守。 飭揚威將軍哈元生等剿撫苗疆。 癸巳，頒大行皇帝遺詔。
In month 8 of Yongzheng 13, on dinghai day, Yongzheng took ill. At Yuanmingyuan, Hongli and Prince He Hongzhou kept constant vigil at his bedside. On wuzi day, dying Yongzheng summoned Yunlu, Yunli, Ortai, Zhang Tingyu, Fengsheng'e, Neqin, and Haiwang for his final instructions. On jichou day Yongzheng died. Ministers asked to bring the late emperor's coffin back to the Forbidden City. Yunlu opened Yongzheng's sealed heir choice; Hongli was proclaimed and ascended. Hongli followed Yongzheng's will: Yunlu, Yunli, Ortai, and Zhang Tingyu would rule jointly; Ortai returned from sick leave. His mother became Empress Dowager; Consort Yuan was raised to Empress. Zhu Shi was recalled to Beijing. Ji Zengyun took charge of Zhejiang seawalls; Zhao Hong'en acted as Jiangnan canal governor-general. Yongzheng's coffin was prepared; the south wing of Qianqing became the mourning lodge. On gengyin day, regents were told to plan the three-year mourning. Yunxiang was put in temporary charge of the Board of Rites. Zhang Zhao was recalled; Zhang Guangsi took the Miao command; Mai Zhu acted at Huguang. Cha Lang'a was posted to Jiuquan with Liu Yuyi; Fu Peng was told to hold the northern line. Ha Yuansheng and others were ordered to fight and pacify the Miao. On guisi day Yongzheng's death edict was issued.
4
九月丁酉朔，日食。 高起、憲德俱罷，仍帶尚書銜。 以鄂爾泰總理兵部事，果親王允禮總理刑部事，莊親王允祿總理工部事，甘汝來為漢兵部尚書，傅鼐署滿兵部尚書。 己亥，上即位於太和殿，以明年為乾隆元年。 庚子，定三年喪制，卻群臣以日易月之請。 命大學士朱軾協同總理事務王大臣辦事。 辛酉，召史貽直來京。 壬寅，止進獻方物。 禁內廷行走僧人招搖。 頒乾隆元年時憲書。 鑄乾隆通寶。 遣官頒詔朝鮮。 丙辰，賑甘肅蘭州、平涼等處旱災。 丙午，命慶復往北路軍營，代回福彭。 手敕額駙策凌勿離軍營。 丁未，大行皇帝梓宮安奉雍和宮。 戊申，上詣雍和宮行禮。 自是日至乙卯以為常。 己酉，賞莊親王允祿、果親王允禮雙俸，鄂爾泰、張廷玉世襲一等輕車都尉，朱軾世襲騎都尉。 庚戌，召楊名時來京。 辛亥，命海望署戶部尚書，傅鼐署刑部尚書。 乙卯，上詣雍和宮行大祭禮。 奉皇太后居永仁宮。 是日，上移居養心殿。 命廷臣輪班條奏，各舉所知。 戊午，賞李紱侍郎銜，命管戶部三庫事。 己未，上詣雍和宮梓宮前行月祭禮。 自是迄奉移，每月如之。 再免民欠丁賦，並諭官吏侵蝕者亦免之。 逮傅爾丹下獄。 庚申，開鄉會試恩科。 免貴州被擾州縣之額賦，未擾者停徵。 辛酉，上詣田村孝敬皇后梓宮前致祭。 以本年鄉試弊多，逮治考官顧祖鎮、戴瀚。 大學士馬齊乞休，允之。 癸亥，召署河東鹽政孫家淦來京，以侍郎用。
On the first of the ninth month, dingyou day, the sun was eclipsed. Gao Qi and Xiande left office but kept minister titles. Ortai took War; Yunli Punishments; Yunlu Works; Gan Rulai and Fu Nai headed the two War ministries. On jihai day Hongli ascended at Taihedian; the next year began Qianlong. On gengzi day he upheld full three-year mourning and rejected shortening it to twenty-seven days. Zhu Shi was ordered to assist the regent council. On xinyou day Shi Yizhi was recalled to Beijing. On renyin day provincial tribute offerings were stopped. Soliciting monks in the Inner Court were banned. The Qianlong 1 calendar was promulgated. New Qianlong coinage was minted. Envoys announced the new reign in Korea. On bingchen day drought relief was ordered for Gansu. On bingwu day Qing Fu went north to replace the returning Fu Peng. Hongli personally ordered Tsewang to remain with the army. On dingwei day Yongzheng's coffin was placed at Yonghe gong. On wushen day Hongli paid rites at Yonghe. He did the same each day through yimao. On jiyou day Yunlu and Yunli received double stipends; Ortai and Zhang Tingyu, hereditary colonels; Zhu Shi, hereditary captain. On gengxu day Yang Mingshi was recalled. On xinhai day Haiwang acted at Revenue; Fu Nai at Punishments. On yimao day he offered the great mourning rite at Yonghe. The Empress Dowager moved to Yongren Palace. The same day Hongli took up residence in the Hall of Mental Cultivation. Officials were told to report in turn and recommend talent. On wuwu day Li Fu received vice-minister rank and the Revenue treasuries. On jiwei day he offered the monthly rite before the coffin at Yonghe. Monthly rites continued until the coffin was transferred. Arrears in poll and land tax were forgiven again, including sums officials had skimmed. Fu Erdan was sent to prison. On gengshen day the enke provincial and metropolitan exams began. War-ravaged Guizhou counties were exempted from quota tax; peaceful ones had levies halted. On xinyou day he sacrificed before Empress Xiaojing's coffin at Tiancun. Exam fraud led to the arrest of provincial examiners Gu Zuzhen and Dai Han. Ma Qi retired with approval. On guihai day Sun Jiagan was recalled from salt duty for a vice-minister post.
5
冬十月丙寅朔，饗太廟，遣裕親王廣保代行。 命副將軍常德赴北路軍營。 丁卯，申禁各省貢獻。 以張廣泗為征苗經略，揚威將軍哈元生、副將軍董芳以下俱聽節制。 庚午，命履郡王允祹管禮部，召原任尚書涂天相來京。 辛未，以任蘭枝為禮部尚書。 壬申，免江南等省漕糧蘆課及學租雜稅。 命治曾靜、張熙罪。 加左都御史福敏太子太保。 以王大臣辦事遲延疏縱，申諭嚴明振作，毋與用寬之意相左。 調徐本為刑部尚書，涂天相為工部尚書。 丙子，以劉勷為直隸河道總督。 丁丑，起彭維新為左都御史。 命徐本軍機處行走。 癸未，停諸王兼管部院事。 甲申，授海望戶部尚書。 己丑，命來保署工部尚書，兼管內務府。 癸巳，傅爾丹、岳鍾琪、石雲倬、馬蘭泰論斬。 甲午，改訥親、海望、徐本為協辦總理事務，納延泰行走，如班第等例。 豐盛額、莽鵠立罷。 庚子，張照下獄鞫治。 壬寅，湖北忠峒等十五土司改土歸流，分置一府五縣，於恩施縣建府治，名曰施南府，分設縣治，名曰宣恩、來鳳、咸豐、利川。 乙巳，申諭薦舉博學鴻詞。 丁未，上大行皇帝尊諡曰敬天昌運建中表正文武英明寬仁信毅大孝至誠憲皇帝，廟號世宗，次日頒詔覃恩有差。 免四川巴縣等旱災額賦。 戊申，召邁柱來京，以史貽直署湖廣總督。 庚戌，以孫嘉淦為左都御史。 癸丑，命慶復為定邊大將軍，赴北路軍營。 命孫嘉淦仍兼管吏部。 諭赦降苗罪。 免貴州三年內耗羨。 丙辰，上詣田村上孝敬憲皇后尊諡曰孝敬恭和懿順昭惠佑天翊聖憲皇后，次日頒詔覃恩有差。 改河東總督仍為河南巡撫，以傅德為之。 丁巳，授鍾保湖南巡撫，俞兆岳江西巡撫。 命岱林布為右衛將軍。 己未，以平郡王福彭協辦總理事務。 董芳、元展成、德希壽褫職逮問，奪哈元生揚威將軍，命經略張廣泗兼貴州巡撫。 癸亥，賞阿其那、塞思黑子孫紅帶，收入玉牒。 甲子，以王大臣會刑部夾訊李禧、耿韜，命審訊大臣宜存大體。
On the first of the tenth month, the ancestral offering was delegated to Prince Yu Guangbao. Changde was sent to the northern front. On dingmao day provincial tribute was banned again. Zhang Guangsi became Miao campaign coordinator over Ha Yuansheng, Dong Fang, and subordinates. On gengwu day Yunxiang took Rites; Tu Tianxiang was recalled. On xinwei day Ren Lanzhi became Minister of Rites. On renshen day Jiangnan canal surcharges and school levies were forgiven. Zeng Jing and Zhang Xi were ordered brought to trial. Fu Min was raised to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent. Hongli rebuked slow, slack regents: be firm and alert, not lax in the name of mercy. Xu Ben took Punishments; Tu Tianxiang, Works. On bingzi day Liu Le became Zhili canal governor-general. On dingchou day Peng Weixin returned as Left Censor-in-Chief. Xu Ben was assigned to the Grand Council. On guimao day princes ceased concurrently heading ministries. On jiashen day Haiwang became Minister of Revenue. On jichou day Laibao acted at Works and the Imperial Household. On guisi day Fu Erdan, Yue Zhongqi, Shi Yuncong, and Ma Lantai received death sentences. On jiawu day Neqin, Haiwang, and Xu Ben became assistant regents; Nayantai joined council duty like Bandi. Fengsheng'e and Manghuli left office. On gengzi day Zhang Zhao was jailed for investigation. On renyin day fifteen Hubei tusi were abolished for counties under the new Shinan prefecture at Enshi. On yisi day Hongli cautioned scholars recommending Erudite Literati candidates. On dingwei day Yongzheng received his posthumous title and temple name Shizong; amnesty followed next day. Sichuan drought counties including Baxian were exempted from quota tax. On wushen day Mai Zhu was recalled; Shi Yizhi acted at Huguang. On gengxu day Sun Jiagan became Left Censor-in-Chief. On guichou day Qing Fu became border pacification general and went north. Sun Jiagan kept concurrent charge of Personnel. Surrendered Miao were pardoned. Guizhou surcharges for three years were forgiven. On bingchen day Empress Xiaojing received her full posthumous title at Tiancun; amnesty followed next day. Hedong was downgraded to Henan governorship under Fu De. On dingsi day Zhong Bao took Hunan and Yu Zhaoyue Jiangxi. Dai Linbu was made general of the Right Guard. On jiwei day, Prince of Ping Fu Peng was appointed to help manage state affairs. Dong Fang, Yuan Zhancheng, and De Xishou were dismissed and imprisoned; Ha Yuansheng lost his general's rank; Zhang Guangsi became Guizhou governor as well as frontier commissioner. On guihai day, Yinsi and Yintang's descendants received red girdles and were restored to the clan register. On jiazi day, Wang Dachen joined the Ministry of Justice in investigating Li Xi and Geng Tao; examiners were told to uphold proper standards.
6
十二月丙寅朔，以博第為吉林將軍，吳禮布為黑龍江將軍。 復設川陝總督，裁四川總督。 戊辰，賑安徽泗州、湖北潛江水災。 癸酉，免浙江、山東、福建、廣東鹽場欠課。 戊寅，上皇太后徽號曰崇慶皇太后，次日頒詔覃恩有差。 己卯，以準噶爾遣使請和，命喀爾喀扎薩克等詳議定界事宜。 庚辰，調傅鼐為刑部尚書，仍兼管兵部。 甲申，磔曾靜、張熙於巿。 都統李禧以贓，尚書高起以欺罔，俱論斬。 丙戌，命嵇曾筠兼管浙江巡撫。 以高斌為江南河道總督。 設歸化城將軍及副都統。 辛卯，晉封訥親一等公，世襲。
On the first of the twelfth month, Bodai became Jilin general and Wu Libu Heilongjiang general. The Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general post was restored and the Sichuan-only post abolished. On wuchen day, flood relief was sent to Suzhou in Anhui and Qianjiang in Hubei. On guiyou day, unpaid salt taxes in Zhejiang, Shandong, Fujian, and Guangdong were forgiven. On wuyin day, the Empress Dowager received the title Chongqing; the next day a grace edict was promulgated. On jimao day, with Dzungar envoys seeking peace, Khalkha princes were told to negotiate the frontier. On gengchen day, Fu Tai became Minister of Justice while retaining charge of the War Board. On jiashen day, Zeng Jing and Zhang Xi were executed by lingchi. Li Xi was condemned to death for embezzlement; Gao Qi for fraud. On bingxu day, Ji Zengyun was made acting Zhejiang governor. Gao Bin became Jiangnan canal commissioner. Posts of general and deputy commander were created at Guihua City. On xinmao day, Neqin was raised to hereditary first-rank duke.
7
乾隆元年春正月丙申朔，上詣堂子行禮。 至觀德殿更素服，詣雍和門行禮畢，率諸王大臣詣慈寧宮行禮。 御太和殿受朝，不作樂，不宣表。 戊戌，命北路參贊大臣薩木哈回京。 辛丑，祈穀於上帝，親詣行禮。 自是每年如之。 癸卯，建京師先蠶壇。 準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零遣使貢方物。 丁未，準噶爾貢使吹納木喀入覲。 召大將軍慶復回京。 命伊勒慎、阿成阿、哈岱為參贊大臣，協同額駙策凌辦事，駐鄂爾坤。 命都統王常、侍郎柏修往鄂爾坤勘屯田。 丙辰，以顧琮署江蘇巡撫。 己未，署湖南永州鎮總兵崔起潛妄劾鄂爾泰、張廣泗，褫職逮治。 南掌入貢。 庚辰，上啟蹕謁陵。 癸亥，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵。 賑臺灣諸羅縣地震災民。 賑甘肅固原、四川忠州等州縣旱災。
On New Year's day of Qianlong 1, the Emperor worshipped at the tangzi. After changing into mourning garb at Guande Hall and rites at Yonghe Gate, he led princes and ministers to Cining Palace. He received court at the Hall of Supreme Harmony without music or edict proclamation. On wuxu day, Northern Route commissioner Samuha was recalled to Beijing. On xinchou day, the Emperor personally prayed for grain at Heaven. Henceforth this was done every year. On guimao day, Beijing's Sericulture Altar was erected. The Dzungar leader Galdan Tseren sent tribute envoys. On dingwei day, Dzungar envoy Choinimka had audience. General Qingfu was recalled to Beijing. Yilejen, Acheng'a, and Hadai were made frontier commissioners to assist Tsering at Orkhon. Wang Chang and Bai Xiu were sent to Orkhon to survey military farms. On bingchen day, Gu Cong became acting Jiangsu governor. On jiwei day, Cui Qiqian was dismissed and arrested for falsely accusing Ortai and Zhang Guangsi. Lan Xang sent tribute. On gengchen day, the Emperor departed to visit the imperial tombs. On guihai day, he worshipped at the imperial mausoleums. Taiwan's Zhuluo earthquake victims received relief. Drought relief went to Guyuan in Gansu, Zhongzhou in Sichuan, and other districts.
8
二月丙寅，上還京師。 戊辰，祭大社、大稷，上親詣行禮。 自是每年如之。 以補熙署漕運總督。 甲戌，遣準噶爾來使歸，詔以遵皇考諭旨，酌定疆界，齎示噶爾丹策零。 乙卯，賜準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零敕書，斥所請以哲爾格西喇呼魯蘇為界，及專令喀爾喀內徙。 庚辰，命邁柱兼管工部。 申飭陳奏謬妄之謝濟世、李徽、陳世倌等。 加楊名時禮部尚書銜，管國子監祭酒事。 辛酉，朝鮮國王李昑遣使進香，賞賚如例。 甲申，命改嵇曾筠為浙江總督，兼管兩浙鹽政。 郝玉麟以閩浙總督專管福建事。 戊子，定世宗山陵名曰泰陵。 己丑，達賴喇嘛及貝勒頗羅鼐遣使貢方物。 辛卯，以程元章為漕運總督。 癸巳，尹繼善奏克空稗、台雄等寨。 張廣泗奏克大小丹江等處。
In the second month, on bingyin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing. On wuchen day, the Emperor personally offered to the gods of earth and grain. Henceforth this was done every year. Bu Xi became acting grain-transport commissioner. On jiaxu day, the Dzungar envoy returned with an edict on border demarcation for Galdan Tseren per Yongzheng's instructions. On yimao day, an imperial letter rebuked Galdan Tseren's border demands and unilateral Khalkha resettlement proposal. On gengchen day, Mai Zhu was given charge of the Works Board. Xie Jishi, Li Hui, and Chen Shiguang were rebuked for reckless memorials. Yang Mingshi received Rites Minister rank and headed the Imperial Academy. On xinyou day, Korea's King Yi Geun sent incense bearers and received customary gifts. On jiashen day, Ji Zengyun became Zhejiang governor-general with control of salt revenue. Hao Yulin, as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general, took charge of Fujian alone. On wuzi day, Yongzheng's tomb was named Tailing. On jichou day, the Dalai Lama and Pholhanas sent tribute envoys. On xinmao day, Cheng Yuanzhang became grain-transport commissioner. On guisi day, Yin Jishan reported capture of Kongbai and Taixiong stockades. Zhang Guangsi reported victory at Greater and Lesser Danjiang.
9
三月庚子，釋汪景琪、查嗣庭親族回籍。 乙巳，加上太祖尊諡曰太祖承天廣運聖德神功肇紀立極仁孝睿武端毅欽安弘文定業高皇帝，孝慈皇后尊諡曰孝慈昭憲敬順仁徽懿德慶顯承天輔聖高皇后； 太宗尊諡曰太宗應天興國弘德彰武寬溫仁聖睿孝敬敏昭定隆道顯功文皇帝，孝端皇后尊諡曰孝端正敬仁懿哲順慈僖莊敏輔天協聖文皇后，孝莊皇后尊諡曰孝莊仁宣誠憲恭懿至德純徽翊天啟聖文皇后； 世祖尊諡曰世祖體天隆運定統建極英睿欽文顯武大德弘功至仁純孝章皇帝，孝惠皇后尊諡曰孝惠仁憲端懿慈淑恭安純德順天翼聖章皇后，孝康皇后尊諡曰孝康慈和莊懿恭惠溫穆端靖崇天育聖章皇后； 聖祖尊諡曰聖祖合天弘運文武睿哲恭儉寬裕孝敬誠信中和功德大成仁皇帝，孝誠皇后尊諡曰孝誠恭肅正惠安和淑懿儷天襄聖仁皇后，孝昭皇后尊諡曰孝昭靜淑明惠正和安裕欽天順聖仁皇后，孝恭皇后尊諡曰孝恭宣惠溫肅定裕慈純贊天承聖仁皇后。 丁未，免四川涼山等處番民額賦。 己酉，免肅州威魯堡回民舊欠。 庚戌，以固原提督樊廷為駐哈密總督。 乙卯，免廣東歸善等四縣加增漁稅及通省逋賦。
In the third month, on gengzi day, families of Wang Jingqi and Zha Sitin were freed to return home. On yisi day, augmented posthumous titles were conferred on Nurhaci and Empress Xiaocigao. Posthumous titles were augmented for Hong Taiji, Empress Xiaoduan, and Empress Xiaozhuang. Posthumous titles were augmented for Shunzhi, Empress Xiaohui, and Empress Xiaokang. Posthumous titles were augmented for Kangxi and Empresses Xiaocheng, Xiaozhao, and Xiaogong. On dingwei day, tribal taxes in Sichuan's Liangshan were forgiven. On jiyou day, old debts of Suzhou's Weilu Muslim community were forgiven. On gengxu day, Fan Ting became governor-general at Hami. On yimao day, extra fishing taxes and provincial arrears in Guangdong were forgiven.
10
夏四月丙寅，免江南阜寧等州縣緩徵漕糧。 壬申，命王常、海瀾為參贊大臣，協同額駙策凌辦事。 以高其倬為湖北巡撫，暫署湖南巡撫。 戊寅，以王士俊為四川巡撫。 辛巳，貴州提督哈元生褫職逮問。 裁直隸副總河，以總督兼管河務。 戊子，賜金德瑛等三百三十四名進士及第出身有差。 壬辰，布魯克巴部諾顏林沁齊壘喇布濟至西藏請上安，並貢方物。
In the fourth month, deferred canal grain taxes in Jiangnan were forgiven. On renshen day, Wang Chang and Hailan were made frontier commissioners to assist Tsering. Gao Qizhuo became Hubei governor and acting Hunan governor. On wuyin day, Wang Shijun became Sichuan governor. On xinsi day, Ha Yuansheng was dismissed and arrested. The Zhili deputy canal post was abolished; the governor-general took charge of river works. On wuzi day, Jin Deying and 333 others received jinshi degrees. On renchen day, a Bhutanese ruler sought imperial blessing in Tibet and sent tribute.
11
五月丁未，賑河南永城縣水災。 壬子，命江南副總河移駐徐州。 甲寅，免四川南溪等州縣被風雹額賦。 乙卯，朝鮮國王李昑表賀登極及尊崇皇太后，並進方物。 乙巳，暹羅國王參立拍照廣拍馬噓六坤司尤提雅菩挨表謝賜扁，並貢方物。 庚辰，免甘肅伏羌等州縣地震傷亡缺額丁銀。
In the fifth month, on dingwei day, flood relief went to Yongcheng in Henan. On renzi day, the Jiangnan deputy canal commissioner was posted to Xuzhou. On jiayin day, storm-damaged districts in Sichuan received tax relief. Korea's King Yi Geun congratulated the new reign and the Empress Dowager and sent tribute. On yisi day, the King of Siam thanked the court for an imperial plaque and sent tribute. On gengchen day, poll-tax shortfalls from Gansu earthquake victims were forgiven.
12
六月戊辰，賑江蘇蕭縣等州縣水災。 己巳，以慶復署吏部尚書，仍兼署戶部事。 癸酉，授張廣泗貴州總督，兼管巡撫事。 以尹繼善為雲南總督。
In the sixth month, on wuchen day, flood relief went to Jiangsu districts including Xiao County. On jisi day, Qingfu became acting Personnel Minister while still acting Revenue Minister. On guiyou day, Zhang Guangsi became Guizhou governor-general. Yin Jishan became Yunnan governor-general.
13
秋七月癸巳朔，以貴州流民多就食沅州，免沅州額賦。 甲午，召總理事務王大臣九卿等，宣諭密書建儲諭旨，收藏於乾清宮正大光明扁額上。 己亥，免貴州通省本年額賦。 辛丑，除古州等處苗賦。 甲辰，免崔起潛罪。 丙午，賑江西安福水災。 辛亥，追諡明建文皇帝為恭閔惠皇帝。 賑江南蕭、碭等州縣衛水災。 丁巳，賑甘肅隴西等州縣水雹災。 戊午，調鍾保為湖北巡撫，高其倬為湖南巡撫。 賑湖北漢川等五州縣衛水災。 癸酉，逮問王士俊，尋論斬。 賑廣東南海、潮陽等縣水災。
On the first of the seventh month, Yuanzhou taxes were forgiven because Guizhou refugees gathered there. On jiawu day, the heir-selection secret edict was read to the chief ministers and placed behind the "Upright and Illuminating" plaque. On jihai day, the year's land tax was forgiven throughout Guizhou. On xinchou day, Miao taxes in Guzhou and elsewhere were abolished. On jiachen day, Cui Qiqian was pardoned. On bingwu day, flood relief went to Anfu in Jiangxi. On xinhai day, the Ming emperor Jianwen received the posthumous title Gongmin Hui. Flood relief went to Xiao, Dang, and other Jiangnan districts. On dingsi day, flood and hail relief went to Longxi and other Gansu districts. On wuwu day, Zhong Bao became Hubei governor and Gao Qizhuo Hunan governor. Flood relief went to Hanchuan and four other Hubei districts. On guiyou day, Wang Shijun was arrested and soon condemned to death. Flood relief went to Nanhai, Chaoyang, and other Guangdong counties.
14
八月戊辰，祭大稷、大社，上親詣行禮。 自是每歲如之。 準噶爾部人孟克來降。 庚午，尚書傅鼐有罪免。 乙卯，賑河南南陽等五縣水災。 乙酉，賑喀喇沁飢。 丁亥，兵部尚書通智免，以奉天將軍那蘇圖代之。 調博第為奉天將軍。 以吉爾黨阿為寧古塔將軍。 賑陝西神木、府谷雹災。 辛卯，賑浙江蘭溪等六縣、江南溧水等二十四州縣、湖北潛江等九州縣衛水災。
In the eighth month, on wuchen day, the Emperor personally offered to the gods of grain and earth. Henceforth this was done every year. A Dzungar named Mengke defected. On gengwu day, Minister Fu Tai was dismissed for misconduct. On yimao day, flood relief went to Nanyang and four other Henan counties. On yiyou day, famine relief was sent to Kharachin in Khalkha. On dinghai day, Tongzhi was removed as Minister of War and Nasutu took the post. Bodi became Fengtian general. Jierdang'a was appointed general at Ningguta. Shaanxi's Shenmu and Fugu received hail relief. On xinmao day, flood relief reached Zhejiang, Jiangnan, and Hubei districts in varying numbers.
15
九月丙申，免張照、哈元生、董芳、元展成、德希壽貽誤苗疆罪。 丁酉，禮部尚書楊名時卒。 戊戌，以慶復為刑部尚書，兼管吏部。 命傅鼐暫署兵部尚書。 庚子，停本年秋決。 癸卯，賑浙江安吉等四縣水災。 丙午，上臨大學士朱軾第視疾。 免江西安福水災額賦。 庚戌，大學士朱軾卒，上親臨賜奠。 壬子，賑安徽宿州等二十州縣衛水災。 致仕大學士陳元龍卒。 乙卯，賑江蘇蕭縣等三州縣水災。 己未，御試博學鴻詞一百七十六人於保和殿，授劉綸等官。 賑江蘇無錫等十三州衛水災。 準噶爾台吉車林等來降。
In the ninth month, five officials were forgiven for Miao frontier mistakes. On dingyou day, Yang Mingshi, Minister of Rites, died. On wuxu day, Qingfu became Minister of Justice and acting head of Personnel. Fu Nai was appointed acting Minister of War. On gengzi day, the autumn judicial executions were halted. On guimao day, Zhejiang flood districts received relief. On bingwu day, the Emperor called on the ailing Grand Secretary Zhu Shi. Jiangxi's Anfu had flood taxes forgiven. On gengxu day, Zhu Shi died and the Emperor attended in person to offer mourning gifts. On renzi day, twenty Anhui districts received flood relief. The retired Grand Secretary Chen Yuanlong died. On yimao day, three Jiangsu districts received flood relief. On jiwei day, 176 erudite-scholar candidates were examined at Baohe Hall and offices were awarded. Thirteen Jiangsu prefectures and garrisons received flood relief. Zungar nobles including Chelun surrendered.
16
冬十月壬戌，以邵基為江蘇巡撫。 乙丑，除浙江仁和等州縣水災額賦。 庚午，調岳濬為江西巡撫，以法敏為山東巡撫。 辛未，上奉皇太后送世宗梓宮至泰陵。 庚辰，上奉皇太后還京師。
In the tenth month, Shao Ji became Jiangsu governor. On yichou day, Zhejiang flood counties had taxes forgiven. On gengwu day, Yue Jun went to Jiangxi and Fa Min to Shandong as governors. On xinwei day, the Emperor and Empress Dowager escorted Yongzheng's coffin to Tailing. On gengchen day, the imperial party returned to Beijing.
17
十一月甲午，上始御乾清門聽政。 加嵇曾筠太子太傅。 命徐本為東閣大學士，仍兼管刑部。 以孫家淦為刑部尚書，楊汝穀為左都御史。 以額爾圖為黑龍江將軍。 丙申，免雲南楚雄等四府州縣額賦。 丁酉，賑安徽霍丘等三縣衛、湖北漢川等十三縣一水災。 己酉，冬至，祀天於圜丘，上親詣行禮。 自是每年如之。 己未，賑陝西定邊雹災，江南長洲等十二州縣衛水災。
In the eleventh month, the Emperor resumed governance at Qianqing Gate. Ji Zengyun received the title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent. Xu Ben became an Eastern Pavilion Grand Secretary while keeping charge of Justice. Sun Jiahan became Minister of Justice and Yang Rugu Left Censor-in-chief. E'ertu was appointed general at Heilongjiang. On bingshen day, Yunnan tax quotas were forgiven in four districts. On dingyou day, flood relief reached Anhui and Hubei districts. On jiyou day, the winter solstice sacrifice at the Round Mound was performed by the Emperor in person. The practice continued annually thereafter. On jiwei day, hail and flood relief reached Shaanxi and Jiangnan.
18
十二月辛酉，賑巴林郡王等四旗旱災。 甲子，賑江蘇婁、溧水等十三州縣水災。 乙丑，改江南壽春協為鎮，設總兵。 己巳，免陝西府谷、神木本年雹災額賦。 移南河副總河駐徐州。 丁丑，免安徽泗州衛屯田、長蘆、廣雲灶地水災額賦。 丁亥，岱林布改江寧將軍。 以王常為建威將軍，雅爾圖為參贊大臣。 免兩淮莞瀆等三場水災額賦。
In the twelfth month, four banners including Balin received drought relief. On jiazi day, thirteen Jiangsu districts received flood relief. On yichou day, Shouchun brigade became a garrison with its own commander. On jisi day, Shaanxi hail taxes for Fugu and Shenmu were forgiven. The Southern Rivers deputy was relocated to Xuzhou. On dingchou day, flood taxes were forgiven for Anhui garrison land and saltworks. On dinghai day, Dai Linbu became Jiangning general. Wang Chang received the rank General Who Establishes Might; Ya'ertu became assisting commissioner. Two Huai salt fields had flood taxes forgiven.
19
是歲，朝鮮、南掌、暹羅、安南來貢。
Korea, Lan Xang, Siam, and Annam presented tribute this year.
20
二年春正月庚寅朔，免朝賀。 庚子，召趙弘恩來京。 以慶復為兩江總督。 調那蘇圖為刑部尚書。 以訥親為兵部尚書。 乙巳，以楊超曾為廣西巡撫。 丙午，釋王士俊。 戊子，李衛劾治誠親王府護衛囑託。 上嘉之，賞四團龍褂。
In the second year's first month, the new-year audience was omitted. On gengzi day, Zhao Hongen was called to Beijing. Qingfu became governor-general of the Two Jiangs. Nasutu became Minister of Justice. Neqin became Minister of War. On yisi day, Yang Chaozeng became Guangxi governor. On bingwu day, Wang Shijun was pardoned. On wuzi day, Li Wei charged Prince Cheng's guards with corruption and favoritism. The Emperor praised Li Wei and granted him a four-dragon court robe.
21
二月丙寅，安南國王黎維祜卒，嗣子黎維禕遣使告哀，並貢方物。 癸酉，賑江蘇高郵水災。 戊寅，遣翰林院侍讀嵩壽、修撰陳倓冊封黎維禕為安南國王。 庚辰，孝敬憲皇后發引，上奉皇太后送至泰陵。
In the second month, Annam's king died and his heir sent mourning envoys with tribute. On guiyou day, Gaoyou received flood relief. On wuyin day, Song Shou and Chen Tan were sent to enfeoff Le Duy Y as king of Annam. On gengchen day, the late empress's coffin set out and the Emperor escorted it to Tailing with the Empress Dowager.
22
三月庚寅，葬世宗於泰陵，孝敬憲皇后祔。 壬辰，上還京師。 癸巳，世宗憲皇帝、孝敬憲皇后升祔太廟，頒詔覃恩有差。 辛丑，命保德等頒升祔詔於朝鮮。 甲辰，涂天相罷。 以趙弘恩為工部尚書。 以顧琮協辦吏部尚書。 戊申，命翰林、科道輪進經史奏議。 庚戌，移右衛將軍駐歸化新城，增副都統二。 辛亥，調碩色為四川巡撫。 壬子，調楊永斌為湖北巡撫。
In the third month, Yongzheng was buried at Tailing with his empress enshrined together. On renchen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing. On guisi day, Yongzheng and his empress entered the ancestral temple and a graded amnesty was proclaimed. On xinchou day, Baode's mission carried the enshrinement edict to Korea. On jiachen day, Tu Tianxiang left office. Zhao Hongen became Minister of Works. Gu Cong was assigned to assist the Ministry of Personnel. On wushen day, Hanlin and censorate scholars were told to submit rotating essays on the classics. On gengxu day, the Right Guard headquarters shifted to Guihua New City with two new deputies. On xinhai day, Shuo Se became Sichuan governor. On renzi day, Yang Yongbin became Hubei governor.
23
四月甲子，以旱命刑部清理庶獄。 乙卯，訓飭建言諸臣。 己巳，疏濬清口並江南運河。 賑江蘇江寧、常州二府旱災。 甲戌，祀天於圜丘，奉世宗配饗，次日頒詔覃恩有差。 是日，雨。 釋傅爾丹、陳泰、岳鍾琪。 丙子，免順天直隸額賦。 己卯，召尹繼善來京。 以張允隨署雲南總督。 甲申，免湖北漢川等五州縣衛水災額賦。 南掌入貢。 丁亥，免江蘇蕭、碭二縣水災額賦。
In the fourth month, drought prompted a Ministry of Justice review of common cases. On yimao day, officials who offered advice received imperial correction. On jisi day, dredging began at Qingkou and on the Jiangnan canal. Jiangsu's Nanjing and Changzhou received drought relief. On jiaxu day, the Round Mound sacrifice paired Yongzheng; a graded amnesty followed next day. Rain fell that day. Furdan, Chen Tai, and Yue Zhongqi were pardoned. On bingzi day, Zhili land taxes were forgiven. On jimao day, Yin Jishan was called to Beijing. Zhang Yunsui became acting governor-general of Yunnan. On jiashen day, five Hubei districts had flood taxes forgiven. Lan Xang presented tribute. On dinghai day, two Jiangsu counties had flood taxes forgiven.
24
五月壬辰，賜于敏中等三百二十四人進士及第出身有差。 癸巳，免湖北荊州、安陸二府水災額賦。 乙未，賑河南南陽等十二州縣水災。 戊戌，御試翰林、詹事等官，擢陳大受等三員為一等，餘各升黜有差。 准本年新進士條奏地方利弊。 戊申，免山東正項錢糧一百萬兩。 辛亥，祭地於方澤，奉世宗配饗。 除廣東開建、恩平二縣米稅。 乙卯，除湖南永州等處額外稅。 免安徽宿州水災額賦。 免浙江仁和等四州縣水災額賦。 賑陝西商南、膚施等縣雹災。 甲戌，以御門聽政，澍雨優渥，賜執事諸臣紗疋有差。 辛酉，命直隸試行區田法。 戊戌，賑安徽石埭等六州縣水災。
In the fifth month, 324 candidates including Yu Minzhong received jinshi honors. On guisi day, two Hubei prefectures had flood taxes forgiven. On yiwei day, twelve Henan districts received flood relief. On wuxu day, the palace examination ranked Chen Dashou and two others first among the Hanlin corps. New degree-holders could submit memorials on provincial policy. On wushen day, Shandong's grain tax was cut by one million taels. On xinhai day, the Square Mound rite paired Yongzheng as collateral spirit. Guangdong abolished rice tax in two counties. On yimao day, Hunan's surplus levies were removed. Anhui's Suzhou had flood taxes forgiven. Four Zhejiang districts had flood taxes forgiven. Shaanxi hail districts including Shangnan received relief. On jiaxu day, good rain at court prompted gifts of gauze to officials. On xinyou day, Zhili was told to test Zhao Xu's district-field system. On wuxu day, six Anhui districts received flood relief.
25
秋七月戊子，以永定河決，遣侍衛策楞等分赴盧溝橋、良鄉撫恤災民。 癸卯，命侍衛松福等往文安、霸州等處撫恤災民。 乙未，命顧琮勘永定河衝決各工。 丙申，賑山東德平、陽穀等州縣旱雹各災。 壬寅，賑順直宛平、清苑等八十一州縣衛旱災。 御試續到博學鴻詞於體仁閣，授萬松齡等官。 丙辰，命各省蠲免額賦，已輸者抵作次年正賦，著為令。 賑安徽黟縣等十四州縣水災。
In the seventh month, Yongding River floods sent Celeng and others to aid victims at Lugou and Liangxiang. On guimao day, Song Fu's party relieved flood victims in Hebei towns. On yiwei day, Gu Cong was assigned to survey Yongding River break sites. On bingshen day, Shandong districts including Deping and Yanggu received drought and hail relief. On renyin day, eighty-one Shuntian districts received drought relief. Supplemental erudite scholars were examined at Tiren Hall; Wan Songling and others received posts. On bingchen day, quota tax remissions were ordered; prepayments could offset next year's levy by rule. Fourteen Anhui districts including Yixian received flood relief.
26
八月丁巳朔，賑陝西安塞等三縣雹災。 湖南城步縣瑤匪平。 賑撫甘肅平番等四縣旱災。 命巡漕御史四員分駐淮安、濟寧、天津、通州。 甲戌，命鄂爾泰詳勘直隸河道水利。 丙子，以顧琮署直隸河道總督。 丁丑，免江蘇碭山水災未完額賦十分之七。 壬午，復設貴州威寧鎮總兵官。 築浙江魚鱗大石海塘。 免山東歷城等二十八州縣衛本年旱災額賦。 甲申，賑甘肅會寧旱災，福建霞浦等州縣水災。
In the eighth month, on the new moon of dingsi, three Shaanxi counties received hail relief. Hunan's Chengbu Yao rebels were subdued. Four Gansu counties including Pingfan received drought relief. Four canal censors were posted to Huai'an, Jining, Tianjin, and Tongzhou. On jiaxu day, Ortai was told to survey Zhili waterways. On bingzi day, Gu Cong became acting Zhili river governor-general. On dingchou day, Dangshan's flood tax arrears were cut by seventy percent. On renwu day, Guizhou's Weining garrison commander was reinstated. Zhejiang's stone seawall was constructed. Twenty-eight Shandong districts including Licheng had drought taxes forgiven. On jiashen day, Gansu drought and Fujian flood districts received relief.
27
九月辛卯，調北路參贊大臣哈岱回京，以瑪尼代之。 乙未，準噶爾回民米爾哈書爾來降。 乙未，以楊永斌為江蘇巡撫。 己亥，賑福建閩縣等沿海風災。 甲辰，訓飭科道毋挾私言事。 召史貽直入都。 以德沛為湖廣總督，元展成為甘肅巡撫。 賑山西興縣等十二州縣旱災。 辛亥，賑甘肅寧夏縣水災。 癸丑，免雲南寧州上年夏稅。 乙卯，以那蘇圖署兵部尚書。
In the ninth month, Hadai left the northern front and Mani took his post. On yiwei day, the Dzungar Mir Hashur surrendered. On yiwei day, Yang Yongbin became Jiangsu governor. On jihai day, Fujian coastal wind victims received relief. On jiachen day, censors were warned against partisan memorializing. Shi Yizhi was recalled to Beijing. De Pei took Huguang; Yuan Zhancheng, Gansu. Twelve Shanxi districts including Xing county received drought relief. On xinhai day, Ningxia county received flood relief. On guichou day, Yunnan's Ningzhou had last summer's tax forgiven. On yimao day, Nasutu became acting Minister of War.
28
閏九月癸亥，免河南西華等四縣本年水災額賦。 丁卯，以尹繼善為刑部尚書，兼辦兵部事。 調慶復為雲南總督。 以那蘇圖為兩江總督。 甲戌，賑長蘆、蘆臺等場水災灶戶。 除江西袁州、饒州二府雜稅。 丙子，馬蘭峪陵工竣。 辛巳，賑福建霞浦等二縣風災。 壬午，賑奉天小清河驛水災。 以雲南布政使陳宏謀瀆奏本省墾務，下部嚴議。 賑江蘇上元等二十五州縣水災，並加賑有差。 賑貴州安順等府廳縣雹災。
In the intercalary ninth month, four Henan counties had flood taxes remitted. On dingmao day, Yin Jishan took Punishments and war duties. Qing Fu became Yunnan governor-general. Nasutu became Two Jiangs governor-general. On jiaxu day, saltern flood victims at Changlu and Lutai received relief. Jiangxi abolished surtaxes in Yuanzhou and Raozhou. On bingzi day, Malanyu tomb works were finished. On xinsi day, two Fujian counties received wind relief. On renwu day, Fengtian's Xiaoqing River station received flood relief. Chen Hongmou faced discipline for a disrespectful reclamation memorial. Twenty-five Jiangsu districts received flood relief with extra grants by case. Guizhou hail districts including Anshun received relief.
29
冬十月乙酉朔，賑山西永濟等三縣霜災。 丁亥，修盛京三陵。 戊子，上詣東陵。 辛卯，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵。 乙未，上還京師。 丙申，安西鎮總兵張嘉翰坐剝削軍需論斬。 以崔紀為陝西巡撫，尹會一為河南巡撫，張楷為湖北巡撫。 己亥，大學士尹泰乞休，溫諭留之。 癸卯，賑山東齊河等二十八州衛水災。 免江南淳縣本年蟲災額賦，桃源等三縣未完銀米。 丁未，賑黑龍江水災。 戊申，修奉先殿。 辛亥，免甘肅平番旱災額賦。
In the tenth month, on the new moon of yiyou, three Shanxi counties received frost relief. On dinghai day, Mukden's three imperial tombs were restored. On wuzi day, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs. On xinmao day, he worshipped at Zhaoxi, Xiaoling, and Xiaodong. On yiwei day, the Emperor returned to Beijing. On bingshen day, Anxi commander Zhang Jiahan was condemned to death for squeezing the army. Cui Ji took Shaanxi; Yin Huiyi, Henan; Zhang Kai, Hubei. On jihai day, Yin Tai's retirement plea was met with a stay. On guimao day, twenty-eight Shandong districts received flood relief. Chun county's insect tax was forgiven; Taoyuan and two counties had arrears cleared. On dingwei day, Heilongjiang flood victims received relief. On wushen day, Fengxian Hall was restored. On xinhai day, Pingfan's drought tax was forgiven.
30
十一月乙卯，賑安徽壽州、霍丘旱災。 免陝西靖邊等八州縣本年水災額賦。 丁巳，朝鮮國王李昑請封世子李愃，禮部言年未及歲，上特允之。 癸亥，賑貴州郎岱等三廳縣雹災。 乙丑，除山西河津被水額賦。 丙寅，賑安徽太平等十一州縣衛水災。 辛未，上詣泰陵，改總管為副都統。 免江南銅山、碭山二縣逋賦。 壬寅，祭告泰陵，上釋服。 乙亥，賑甘肅環縣、蘭州，廣東三水等十縣旱災。 上還京師。 戊寅，皇太后聖壽節，御慈寧宮，上率諸王大臣行慶賀禮。 自是每年如之。 己卯，免山西興縣等四州縣旱災丁銀。 庚辰，命仍設軍機處，以大學士鄂爾泰、張廷玉，尚書訥親、海望，侍郎納延泰、班第為軍機大臣。
In the eleventh month, Shouzhou and Huoqiu received drought relief. Eight Shaanxi districts including Jingbian had flood taxes remitted. On dingsi day, Korea's heir investiture was granted despite his youth. On guihai day, three Guizhou districts received hail relief. On yichou day, Hejin's flood tax was forgiven. On bingyin day, eleven Anhui districts received flood relief. On xinwei day, at Tailing the chief steward became a vice commander-in-chief. Jiangnan's Tongshan and Dangshan tax arrears were cleared. On renyin day, Tailing rites were reported and mourning dress ended. On yihai day, Gansu and Guangdong drought districts received relief. The Emperor returned to Beijing. On wuyin day, the court congratulated the Empress Dowager at Cining Palace. The birthday rite became annual. On jimao day, four Shanxi districts had drought poll tax forgiven. On gengchen day, the Grand Council returned with Ortai, Zhang Tingyu, Neqin, Haiwang, Nayantai, and Bandi.
31
十二月甲申朔，漕運總督補熙免，以查克丹代之。 以來保為工部尚書。 免江南阜寧上年水災額賦。 丁亥，上御太和殿，冊立嫡妃富察氏為皇后。 戊子，奉皇太后御慈寧宮，上率諸王大臣行慶賀禮畢，上御太和殿，群臣慶賀，頒詔覃恩有差。 辛卯，免江蘇溧水等十二州縣水災額賦。 壬辰，賑陝西府谷等三縣雹災。 甲午，以冊立皇后禮成，加上皇太后徽號曰崇慶慈宣皇太后。 奉皇太后御慈寧宮，上率諸王大臣行慶賀禮，次日頒詔覃恩有差。 己亥，免直隸本年旱災灶課。 免甘肅寧夏水災額賦。 壬寅，鄂爾泰封三等伯。 賑福建閩縣等六縣、廣東海康等七縣風潮災。 大學士邁柱乞病，許之。 琉球貢方物。 癸卯，張廷玉封三等伯。 辛亥，賑涿州水災。
In the twelfth month, Bu Xi left the grain transport post and Zhakedan succeeded him. Laibao became Minister of Works. Funing's prior flood tax was forgiven. On dinghai day, the Fuca consort was invested empress at Taihe Hall. On wuzi day, empress rites brought court congratulations and a graded amnesty. On xinmao day, twelve Jiangsu districts had flood taxes forgiven. On renchen day, three Shaanxi counties received hail relief. On jiawu day, the empress rite brought the honorific Chongqing Cixuan. Cining congratulations were followed next day by a graded amnesty. On jihai day, Zhili's drought saltern tax was forgiven. Ningxia's flood tax was remitted. On renyin day, Ortai became a third-class baron. Fujian and Guangdong wind-tide districts received relief. Mai Zhu retired sick with approval. Ryukyu paid tribute. On guimao day, Zhang Tingyu became a third-class baron. On xinhai day, Zhuozhou received flood relief.
32
三年春正月甲寅朔，上初舉元正朝賀，率王以下文武大臣詣壽康宮慶賀皇太后，禮成，御太和殿受賀。 自是每年元正如之。 乙卯，以福敏為武英殿大學士，馬爾泰為左都御史。 辛酉，祈穀於上帝，奉世宗配享。 癸亥，命舉行經筵。 甲子，上初幸圓明園，奉皇太后居申昜春園。 戊辰，御正大光明殿，賜朝正外籓及內大臣、大學士宴。 癸酉，以朱藻為直隸河道總督，顧琮協理河道事。 丁丑，準噶爾噶爾丹策零遣使奉表至京，並進貂皮。 遣侍郎阿克敦充正使，御前侍衛旺扎爾、乾清門台吉額默根充副使，齎敕往準噶爾議定界。 己卯，上自圓明園還宮。 辛巳，以謁泰陵，命鄂爾泰在京總理事務。
In year 3, on the New Year new moon, Hongli first held court and congratulated the empress dowager at Shoukang. The New Year court rite became annual. On yimao day, Fu Min joined the Grand Secretariat and Maertai became Left Censor-in-chief. On xinyou day, the grain prayer paired Yongzheng as collateral spirit. On guihai day, the Classics lecture was restored. On jiazi day, Hongli first went to Yuanmingyuan and lodged the empress dowager at Shenyiyang. On wuchen day, he feasted tributary envoys and inner ministers at Zhengda Guangming. On guiyou day, Zhu Zao took Zhili rivers and Gu Cong assisted. On dingchou day, Galdan Tseren's envoys arrived with tribute sables. Agedun led envoys Wangzhar and Emergen to the Dzungars to settle the frontier. On jimao day, the Emperor left Yuanmingyuan for the Forbidden City. On xinsi day, Ortai ran Beijing while the emperor went to Tailing.
33
二月丁亥，釋奠先師孔子。 戊子，幸圓明園。 癸巳，準噶爾使入覲，賞銀幣有差。 戊戌，上謁泰陵。 己亥，上祭泰陵。 辛丑，上幸南苑行圍。 壬寅，上還京師。 丙午，舉行經筵。 自是每季仲月舉行一次，歲以為常。 丁未，免山東齊河等三十二州縣衛水災額賦。 辛亥，上親耕耤田，加一推。 自是每年如之。 壬子，趙弘恩以納賄奪職，以高其倬為工部尚書，張渠為湖南巡撫。
In the second month, on dinghai day, Confucius was honored. On wuzi day, he went to Yuanmingyuan. On guisi day, the Dzungar envoy was received and rewarded. On wuxu day, the Emperor worshipped at Tailing. On jihai day, the Emperor offered sacrifice at Tailing. On xinchou day, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for a hunting round. On renyin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing. On bingwu day, the Classics lecture was held. Thereafter it was held once in each season's middle month as a fixed yearly practice. On dingwei day, flood-assessed tax quotas were remitted for thirty-two Shandong districts including Qihe. On xinhai day, the Emperor personally ploughed the sacred field with one extra push of the plough. This became the annual practice thereafter. On renzi day, Zhao Hong'en lost his post for bribery; Gao Qizhuo became Works Minister and Zhang Qu Hunan governor.
34
三月癸丑朔，賑福建閩縣等八縣颶風災。 甲寅，上詣太學釋奠，御彝倫堂，命講中庸、尚書。 乙卯，調崔紀為湖北巡撫，張楷為西安巡撫。 己未，免江蘇六合等十二州縣水災額賦，廣東三水等十州縣旱災額賦。 辛酉，賑江蘇上元等二十五州縣衛水災，並免額賦。 丁卯，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。 辛未，免甘肅蘭州等處旱災額賦。 壬申，以旱命刑部清理庶獄。 癸酉，免安徽太平等十一州縣衛水災額賦。 丁丑，免湖北沔陽州逋賦。
In the third month, on the first guichou day, eight Fujian counties including Min were relieved after a typhoon. On jiayin day, the Emperor offered sacrifice at the Academy, took the Hall of Constant Norms, and ordered lectures on the Mean and the Documents. On yimao day, Cui Ji became Hubei governor and Zhang Kai Xi'an governor. On jiwei day, water and drought tax quotas were remitted for Jiangsu and Guangdong districts. On xinyou day, twenty-five Jiangsu districts were relieved and their tax quotas remitted after floods. On dingmao day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool. On xinwei day, drought tax quotas were remitted for Gansu districts including Lanzhou. On renshen day, drought prompted orders to review ordinary prisons at the Ministry of Punishments. On guiwei day, flood tax quotas were remitted for eleven Anhui districts including Taiping. On dingchou day, Mianyang's tax arrears in Hubei were forgiven.
35
夏四月甲申，以旱申命求言。 停督撫貢獻。 理籓院尚書僧格休致，以納延泰代之。 己丑，調孫嘉淦為吏部尚書，以趙國麟為刑部尚書，孫國璽為安徽巡撫。 壬辰，命顧琮往直隸會同朱藻辦理河工。 免長蘆蘆臺等場、衡水等州縣水災額賦。
In the fourth month of summer, drought led to renewed orders for candid memorials. Provincial tribute from governors was suspended. Colonial Affairs Minister Sengge retired and Nayantai took his place. On jichou day, Sun Jia'gan became Personnel Minister; Zhao Guolin became Punishments Minister and Sun Guoxi Anhui governor. On renchen day, Gu Zong was sent to Zhili to manage rivers with Zhu Zao. Flood tax quotas were remitted for Changlu salt fields and Hengshui districts.
36
五月癸丑，賑陝西蒲城等十州縣雹災。 己未，賑山東章丘等州縣衛雹災。 庚申，賑陝西雒南等八州縣雹災。 壬戌，貴州定番州苗阿沙等作亂，張廣泗討平之。 辛未，調額爾圖為奉天將軍，博第為黑龍江將軍。 乙亥，免江南松江府額賦。 辛巳，賑陝西靖邊等八州縣旱災。
In the fifth month, ten Shaanxi districts including Pucheng were relieved after hail. On jiwei day, Shandong hail-struck districts including Zhangqiu were relieved. On gengshen day, eight Shaanxi districts including Luonan were relieved after hail. On renxu day, Dingfan Miao rebels led by Asha were suppressed by Zhang Guangsi. On xinwei day, E'ertu became Fengtian general and Bodi Heilongjiang general. On yihai day, Songjiang's assessed tax quota in Jiangnan was remitted. On xinsi day, eight drought-struck Shaanxi districts including Jingbian were relieved.
37
六月庚寅，賑山東東平等四州縣雹災。 丙午，左都御史楊汝穀乞休，允之。
In the sixth month, four Shandong districts including Dongping were relieved after hail. On bingwu day, Left Censor-in-chief Yang Rugu's retirement request was approved.
38
秋七月壬子，起前左都御史彭維新為原官。 丁巳，免福建詔安縣旱災額賦。 癸亥，免浙江溫州等衛漕欠。 乙丑，調史貽直為工部尚書，高其倬為戶部尚書。 丁卯，命查郎阿入閣辦事。 調鄂彌達為川陝總督。 以馬爾泰為兩廣總督，查克丹為左都御史，託時為漕運總督。 大學士尹泰乞休，允之。
In the seventh month, former Left Censor Peng Weixin was reappointed. On dingsi day, Zhao'an's drought tax quota in Fujian was remitted. On guiwei day, Wenzhou garrison grain-transport arrears in Zhejiang were forgiven. On yichou day, Shi Yizhi became Works Minister and Gao Qizhuo Revenue Minister. On dingmao day, Zhalang'a was ordered into the Grand Secretariat. E'mida became Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general. Ma'ertai took the Two Guangs, Chakedan the left censorate, and Tuo Shi the grain transport post. Grand Secretary Yintai's retirement was approved.
39
八月丙戌，江蘇海州、山東郯城等州縣蝗。 賑湖南石門縣、甘肅武威等三縣水災。 己丑，海望丁憂，以訥親暫署戶部尚書。 己亥，奉皇太后謁泰陵。 癸卯，上詣泰陵行三周年祭禮。 丙午，上奉皇太后駐蹕南苑，上行圍。 戊申，賑安徽望江等四十八州衛旱災。
In the eighth month, locusts struck Haizhou in Jiangsu and Tancheng in Shandong. Shimen in Hunan and three Gansu counties including Wuwei were relieved after floods. On jichou day, Haiwang went into mourning and Neqin acted as Revenue Minister. On jihai day, the Emperor led the Empress Dowager to Tailing. On guimao day, the Emperor performed the third-anniversary rites at Tailing. On bingwu day, the Empress Dowager lodged at the Southern Park while the Emperor hunted. On wushen day, forty-eight drought-struck Anhui districts including Wangjiang were relieved.
40
九月庚戌朔，上奉皇太后還宮。 免陝西長安等十五州縣雹災額賦。 賑山東招遠縣雹災。 戊午，免福建漳浦上年旱災額賦。 辛酉，命嵇曾筠入閣辦事，兼理永定河務。 裁浙江總督，復設巡撫，以郝玉麟仍為閩浙總督，盧焯為浙江巡撫。 甲子，朱藻解任，遣訥親、孫嘉淦往鞫之。 以顧琮管總河印務。 安南入貢。 己巳，大學士尹泰卒。 編修彭樹葵進十思箴，上嘉賚之。 賑甘肅碾伯等處旱災。 丁丑，免江蘇江寧等五十二州縣衛水災額賦，並賑之。 戊寅，賑臺灣旱災。
On the first gengxu of the ninth month, the Emperor and Empress Dowager returned to the palace. Hail tax quotas were remitted for fifteen Shaanxi districts including Chang'an. Zhaoyuan in Shandong was relieved after hail. On wuwu day, Zhangpu's prior-year drought tax quota in Fujian was remitted. On xinyou day, Ji Zengyun entered the Grand Secretariat and took charge of Yongding River works. Zhejiang's governor-general post was cut and a governor restored; Hao Yulin stayed Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and Lu Chao became Zhejiang governor. On jiazi day, Zhu Zao left office and Neqin and Sun Jia'gan were sent to investigate him. Gu Zong took charge of the Grand Canal director-general's seal. Annam presented tribute. On jisi day, Grand Secretary Yintai died. Compiler Peng Shukui offered the Ten Reflections Admonition and received imperial praise and gifts. Drought relief was given for Gansu districts including Minzhou. On dingchou day, fifty-two Jiangsu districts including Jiangning had flood quotas remitted and received relief. On wuyin day, Taiwan received drought relief.
41
冬十月庚辰朔，賑陝西安定等六州縣雹災。 辛巳，免山東鄒平等八州縣本年雹災額賦。 壬午，免直隸被水州縣逋賦。 免江蘇、安徽被災各州縣逋賦。 辛卯，皇次子永璉薨，輟朝五日，以御極後，親書永璉為皇太子密旨，一切典禮如皇太子儀。 賑安徽懷寧等五十州縣衛旱災。 壬辰，戶部尚書高其倬卒。 丙申，調任蘭枝為戶部尚書，趙國麟為禮部尚書，史貽直為刑部尚書，以趙殿最為工部尚書。 丁酉，諡皇太子永璉為端慧皇太子。 直隸總督李衛以病免，命孫嘉淦署之。 己亥，賑浙江吉安等州縣旱災。 庚子，朝鮮國王李昑表賀上皇太后徽號並冊封皇后，又表謝恩封世子，附進方物。 壬寅，上幸田村，奠端慧皇太子。 癸卯，免江南、江西、河南漕欠。 乙巳，授孫嘉淦直隸總督，以甘汝來為吏部尚書兼兵部，楊超曾為兵部尚書。 丙午，授顧琮直隸河道總督。
On the first gengchen of the tenth month, six Shaanxi districts including Anding were relieved after hail. On xinsi day, current-year hail tax quotas were remitted for eight Shandong districts including Zouping. On renwu day, flood districts in Zhili had tax arrears forgiven. Disaster districts in Jiangsu and Anhui had tax arrears forgiven. On xinmao day, the second son Yonglian died and court halted five days; he had been named crown prince in a secret edict at accession, and rites followed crown prince usage. Fifty drought-struck Anhui districts including Huaining were relieved. On renchen day, Revenue Minister Gao Qizhuo died. On bingshen day, Ren Lanzhi became Revenue Minister, Zhao Guolin Rites Minister, Shi Yizhi Punishments Minister, and Zhao Dianzui Works Minister. On dingyou day, Crown Prince Yonglian was posthumously titled Duanhui Crown Prince. Li Wei left the Zhili governor-generalship for illness and Sun Jia'gan was ordered to act. On jihai day, drought relief was given for Zhejiang districts including Ji'an. On gengzi day, King Yeongjo of Korea sent memorials on the empress dowager's title and empress's investiture, thanked the heir's enfeoffment, and presented tribute. On renyin day, the Emperor went to Tiancun to mourn Duanhui Crown Prince. On guimao day, grain-transport arrears in Jiangnan, Jiangxi, and Henan were forgiven. On yisi day, Sun Jia'gan became Zhili governor-general; Gan Rulai took Personnel with War, and Yang Chaozeng the War Ministry. On bingwu day, Gu Zong became Zhili river-course governor-general.
42
十一月己酉朔，復廣東海南道為雷瓊道，改高雷道為高廉道。 庚戌，以孫嘉淦劾貝勒允祜，上嘉之，予議敘。 允祜下宗人府嚴議。 壬子，賑江蘇華亭等六縣衛旱災。 賑湖南石門縣旱災。 癸丑，免奉天寧遠等四州縣蟲災額賦。 賑浙江歸安、烏程，陝西綏德等四州縣雹災，湖北孝感等六州縣旱災。 癸丑，免河南信陽等八州縣旱災額賦。 賑湖北應山、四川忠州等三州縣旱災。 乙丑，免江南淮安、徐州二府湖灘額租。 免山東招遠縣雹災額賦。 庚午，大學士嵇曾筠以病乞休，允之。 壬申，甘肅寧夏地震，水涌新渠，寶豐縣治沈沒，發蘭州庫銀二十萬兩，命兵部侍郎班第往賑之。 乙亥，吏部尚書性桂乞休，允之。 丁丑，免直隸宣化各府州逋賦。
On the first jiyou of the eleventh month, Hainan circuit became Lei-Qiong again and Gao-Lei was renamed Gao-Lian. On gengxu day, the Emperor praised Sun Jia'gan for impeaching Prince Yunhu and ordered him rewarded. Prince Yunhu was referred to the Imperial Clan Court for strict judgment. On renzi day, six drought-struck Jiangsu districts including Huating were relieved. Shimen in Hunan received drought relief. On guichou day, insect tax quotas were remitted for four Fengtian districts including Ningyuan. Zhejiang's Gui'an and Wucheng, four Shaanxi hail districts including Suide, and six Hubei drought districts including Xiaogan were relieved. On guichou day, drought tax quotas were remitted for eight Henan districts including Xinyang. Yingshan in Hubei, Zhongzhou in Sichuan, and one other district received drought relief. On yichou day, lake-shoal rent quotas in Huai'an and Xuzhou in Jiangnan were remitted. Zhaoyuan's hail tax quota in Shandong was remitted. On gengwu day, Grand Secretary Ji Zengyun's sick-leave retirement was approved. On renshen day, a Ningxia earthquake flooded the new canal and submerged Baofeng; 200,000 taels were sent and Bandi ordered to relieve the disaster. On yihai day, Personnel Minister Xinggui's retirement was approved. On dingchou day, Xuanhua and other Zhili districts had tax arrears forgiven.
43
十二月乙卯朔，調訥親為吏部尚書。 庚辰，賑四川射洪等六縣水災。 賑兩淮鹽場本年旱災。 丙戌，彭維新褫職，以魏廷珍為左都御史。 丁亥，甘肅寧夏地震。 甲午，賑甘肅平番蟲災。 命大理寺卿汪漋往江南總辦河工。 琉球國王尚敬遣使表賀登極，入貢。 戊戌，準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零遣哈柳等從侍郎阿克敦等至京師，進表。 乙巳，準噶爾使哈柳等入覲，諭曰：「所奏游牧不越阿爾台，朕甚嘉之。 托爾和、布延圖卡倫內移，不可行。 」
On the first yimao of the twelfth month, Neqin became Personnel Minister. On gengchen day, six flood-struck Sichuan counties including Shehong were relieved. This year's drought relief was given to the Two Huai salt fields. On bingxu day, Peng Weixin was dismissed and Wei Tingzhen became Left Censor-in-chief. On dinghai day, Ningxia in Gansu suffered an earthquake. On jiawu day, Pingfan in Gansu received relief from insect damage. Wang Huan was sent to Jiangnan to supervise river works. Ryukyu congratulated the enthronement and presented tribute. On wuxu day, Galdan Tseren sent envoys with A Kedun to present a memorial at court. On yisi day, the Dzungar envoys were received and the Emperor commended their pledge not to pasture beyond the Altai. Inward relocation of the Tuo'erhe and Buyantu cardan posts was rejected. The edict continued.
44
四年春正月己酉，上御乾清宮西暖閣，召王、大臣、翰林、科道及督、撫、學政在京者九十九人賜宴，賦柏梁體詩。 丁卯，免甘肅寧夏等五縣地震被災額賦。 壬申，大學士嵇曾筠卒。 趙國麟為大學士，調任蘭枝為禮部尚書，以陳德華為戶部尚書。
In the fourth year's first month, on jiyou day, the Emperor banqueted ninety-nine officials at the Hall of Heavenly Purity and composed Bo Liang verse. On dingmao day, earthquake tax relief was granted in Gansu. On renshen day, Grand Secretary Ji Zengyun died. Zhao Guolin became Grand Secretary; Ren Lanzhi and Chen Dehua received ministry posts.
45
二月己卯，調張渠為江蘇巡撫，以馮光裕為湖南巡撫。 丙戌，免直隸滄州等四州縣、興國等四場水災灶地額賦。 免貴州郎岱等四廳州縣雹災額賦。 乙未，免甘肅靖遠風災額賦。 丙申，準噶爾部人孟克特穆爾等來降。 免陝西咸寧、鎮安水災，甘肅柳溝衛蟲災額賦。 戊戌，免湖南永順、永綏新辟苗疆鹽課。 免浙江上虞等縣逋賦。 庚子，準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零請以阿爾泰山為界，許之。 免湖北鍾祥等五縣衛旱災額賦。
In the second month, Zhang Qu and Feng Guangyu were appointed provincial governors. On bingxu day, saltern land tax was remitted for flood areas in Zhili. Hail disaster tax relief was granted in Guizhou. On yiwei day, Jingyuan received wind-disaster tax relief. On bingshen day, Mengke Temur and other Dzungars submitted. Flood and insect disaster taxes were remitted in Shaanxi and Gansu. On wuxu day, salt levies were remitted in Hunan's new Miao districts. Arrears were forgiven in Zhejiang counties including Shangyu. On gengzi day, the Altai border requested by Galdan Tseren was approved. Drought tax relief was granted in Hubei.
46
三月丁未朔，己酉，召雅爾圖來京，以阿蘭泰為北路參贊大臣。 免安徽宿州等四州縣逋賦。 吏部奏行取屆期，上命尚書、都御史、侍郎保舉如陸隴其、彭鵬者。 免湖北應山上年旱災額賦。 甲子，設熱河兵備道，駐承德州。 命訥親協辦大學士。 戊辰，以旱災特免直隸、江蘇、安徽三省額賦。 壬申，以魏廷珍為工部尚書。 賑直隸文安等六縣水災。
In the third month, Yartu was called to Beijing and Alan Tai became Northern Route assistant commander. Tax arrears were remitted in Anhui. The Emperor ordered high officials to recommend men of Lu Longqi and Peng Peng's caliber for singled promotion. Prior-year drought tax was remitted in Hubei Yingshan. On jiazi day, the Rehe defense circuit was set up at Chengde. Neqin was assigned to assist the Grand Secretaries. On wuchen day, drought brought special tax remissions in Zhili, Jiangsu, and Anhui. On renshen day, Wei Tingzhen became Minister of Works. Flood relief was granted in Zhili.
47
夏四月丁卯，免安徽壽州上年旱災額賦。 戊寅，免江蘇丹陽等七縣旱災額賦。 辛巳，賜莊有恭等三百二十八人進士及第出身有差。 壬午，免長蘆上年旱災逋賦。 丙戌，以旱申命求言。 命刑部清理庶獄，減徒以下罪。 甲午，免四川忠州等三州縣旱災額賦。 乙未，以陳世倌為左都御史。 癸卯，西藏巴勒布部庫庫木、顏布、葉楞三汗入貢。
In the fourth month, prior-year drought tax for Shouzhou was remitted. On wuyin day, drought tax relief was granted in Jiangsu. On xinsi day, Zhuang Yougong and 328 others received jinshi degrees. On renwu day, Changlu drought arrears were forgiven. On bingxu day, the drought prompted an appeal for memorialized advice. The Ministry of Punishments was ordered to review routine prisons and reduce lesser sentences. On jiawu day, Sichuan drought taxes were remitted. On yiwei day, Chen Shiguai became Left Censor-in-chief. On guimao day, three Tibetan khans of Balipu presented tribute.
48
五月甲子，朝鮮國王李昑謝賜本國列傳，進方物。 戊辰，改築浙江海寧石塘。 辛未，致仕大學士馬齊卒。 癸酉，加鄂爾泰、張廷玉、福敏太保，徐本、訥親太子太保，甘汝來、海望、鄂善、尹繼昌、徐元夢、孫嘉淦、慶復太子少保。
In the fifth month, Korea's king thanked the dynasty for his state's historical biography and sent gifts. On wuchen day, Haining's stone seawall was rebuilt. On xinwei day, retired Grand Secretary Ma Qi died. On guiyou day, E'ertai, Zhang Tingyu, Fu Min, Xu Ben, Neqin, and others received honorific tutor titles.
49
六月庚辰，調碩色為山東巡撫，方顯為四川巡撫。 甲辰，免甘肅赤金所上年被災額賦。 山東濟南等七府蝗。 曹縣河決，仍賑被水六州縣災民。 甘肅秦安等六州縣雹災。
In the sixth month, Shuo Se and Fang Xian were reassigned as governors. On jiachen day, prior-year disaster tax for Chijin was remitted. Locusts struck seven Jinan-area prefectures in Shandong. Cao County's river breach brought renewed relief to six flooded prefectures and counties. Hail struck six prefectures and counties in Gansu including Qin'an.
50
秋七月戊申，額駙策凌奏率兵駐鄂爾海西拉烏蘇，並分兵駐鄂爾坤河、齊齊爾里克、額爾德尼招、塔密爾、烏里雅蘇台附近，防範準噶爾。 庚戌，以甘肅秦安等十五州縣雹災，命無論已未成災，悉免本年額賦。 辛酉，賑河南祥符等四十七州縣水災。 壬戌，賑山東海豐等縣場灶戶。 甲子，賑江蘇睢寧等十三州縣衛水雹各災，湖北房縣旱災。 丙寅，吏部尚書甘汝來卒。 以郝玉麟為吏部尚書，宗室德沛為閩浙總督，以班第為湖廣總督。 己巳，賑安徽宿州雹災。 庚申，安南馬郎叛人矣長等來降。 賑山東利津等二縣雹災。 壬申，賑直隸開州等州縣、江蘇海州等州縣水災。 江蘇淮安、安徽鳳陽等府州蝗。
In the seventh month, Celeng reported troop deployments along the Ergune and nearby posts to guard against Dzungars. On gengxu day, all current-year tax was remitted for fifteen Gansu hail-hit prefectures and counties. On xinyou day, flood relief was granted across Henan. On renxu day, Shandong saltern households received relief. On jiazi day, disaster relief was granted in Jiangsu and drought relief in Hubei Fang. On bingyin day, Gan Rulai died. Hao Yulin, Depei, and Ban Di received high appointments. On jisi day, hail relief was granted in Anhui Suzhou. On gengshen day, Annam rebels including Yi Chang submitted. Hail relief was granted in Shandong Lijin and another county. On renshen day, flood relief was granted in Zhili and Jiangsu. Locusts appeared in Jiangsu Huai'an and Anhui Fengyang.
51
八月丙子，御史張湄劾諸大臣阻塞言路。 上斥為漸染方苞惡習，召見滿、漢奏事大臣諭之。 辛巳，賑河南商丘等州縣水災。 壬午，敘張廣泗經理苗疆功，授三等輕車都尉，黃廷桂等加銜、加級有差。 戊子，賑山東歷城等六十六州縣衛所水災，停徵新舊額賦。 庚寅，江蘇金壇縣貢生蔣振生進手鈔十三經，賜國子監學正銜。
In the eighth month, Zhang Mei accused senior ministers of blocking memorialized criticism. The Emperor denounced Zhang Mei's charge as Fang Bao's influence and lectured reporting ministers. On xinsi day, Henan flood victims received relief. On renwu day, Zhang Guangsi was rewarded for Miao frontier service and Huang Tinggui and others were honored. On wuzi day, Shandong flood relief was granted and tax collection suspended in sixty-six jurisdictions. On gengyin day, Jiang Zhensheng was rewarded for presenting a manuscript of the Thirteen Classics.
52
九月乙巳朔，署廣西提督譚行義以安南鄭氏專柄，清化鎮邵郡公及黎鷟起兵與鄭氏內閧，奏聞。 丙午，免江蘇海州、贛榆二州被水漕糧。 戊申，賑河南祥符等三十七州縣水災有差。 丁巳，上奉皇太后謁陵。 庚申，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵。 賑山東臨邑等縣水災。 癸亥，賑甘肅張掖東樂堡水災。 賑河南鄧州等四州縣水災，山西榆次等三縣旱災。 命停徵江蘇、安徽漕糧。 上奉皇太后還宮。 庚午，上以疾命和親王弘晝代行孟冬時饗禮。 免甘肅秦安等十五州縣糧草三分之一，及靈州、碾伯等州縣本年水雹各災額賦。
In the ninth month, Tan Xingyi reported civil war in Annam between the Zheng clan and rival forces. On bingwu day, transport grain was remitted for flooded Haizhou and Ganyu. On wushen day, differentiated flood relief went to thirty-seven Henan jurisdictions. On dingsi day, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to the tombs. On gengshen day, the Emperor visited several imperial tombs. Flood relief was granted in Shandong Linyi and elsewhere. On guihai day, Zhangye's Dongyue Fort received flood relief. Flood and drought relief went to Henan and Shanxi. Transport grain collection was suspended in Jiangsu and Anhui. The imperial party returned to the palace. On gengwu day, illness led the Emperor to delegate mid-winter sacrifices to Hong Zhou. Tax and fodder relief was granted across Gansu disaster areas.
53
冬十月丁丑，準噶爾回人伊斯拉木定來降。 庚辰，以江蘇海州等四州縣水災，免逋賦。 甲申，端慧皇太子周年，上幸田村奠酒。 乙酉，賑山東歷城等六十六州縣水災，給葺屋銀。 丁亥，免陝西興平等十六州縣雹災額賦。 己丑，莊親王允祿、理親王弘晰等緣事，宗人府議削爵圈禁。 上曰：「莊親王寬免。 理親王弘晰、貝勒弘昌、貝子弘普俱削爵。 弘升永遠圈禁。 弘晈王爵，系奉皇考特旨，從寬留王號，停俸。 」丙申，釋馬蘭泰。 己亥，額魯特札薩克多羅郡王、和碩額駙阿寶之妻和碩格格進顧實汗所傳玉璽，諭還之。 壬寅，召定邊左副將軍額駙策凌來京。 封弘勩郡王，襲理親王爵。 癸卯，上幸南苑行圍。
In the tenth month, Yisilamu Ding of the Dzungars submitted. On gengchen day, Jiangsu flood areas received arrears relief. On jiashen day, the Emperor marked Crown Prince Duanhui's anniversary at Tiancun. On yiyou day, Shandong flood victims received relief and repair funds. On dinghai day, hail tax was remitted in Shaanxi. On jichou day, Yin Lu, Hong Xi, and others faced clan-court punishment. The Emperor pardoned Prince Zhuang. Hong Xi, Hong Chang, and Hong Pu lost their titles. Hong Sheng was placed in permanent confinement. Hong Jiao kept his princely title but lost his stipend by imperial favor. On bingshen day, Ma Lantai was freed. On jihai day, a princess returned Gush Khan's jade seal to the court by imperial order. On renyin day, Celeng was recalled to Beijing. Hong Yong became commandery prince and inherited the principality. On guimao day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.
54
十一月丙午，上行大閱禮，連發五矢皆中的，賜在事王大臣銀幣有差。 戊申，以郝玉麟署兩江總督。 庚戌，召尹會一來京，以雅爾圖為河南巡撫。 賑江蘇安東等十五州縣水災有差。 壬申，免寧夏次年額賦。
In the eleventh month, the Emperor's grand review hit five successive targets and officials were rewarded. On wushen day, Hao Yulin became acting Liangjiang governor-general. On gengxu day, Yin Huiyi was recalled and Yartu became Henan governor. Differentiated flood relief was granted in Jiangsu. On renshen day, next year's Ningxia land tax was waived.
55
十二月癸酉朔，免山東金鄉等六州衛水災額賦。 丙子，免浙江安吉等州縣漕糧，河南羅山旱災額賦。 戊寅，弘晰坐問安泰「準噶爾能否到京，上壽算如何」，擬立絞。 諭免死，永遠圈禁，安泰論絞。 免陝西榆林等十一州縣逋賦。 癸未，免河南祥符等四十四州縣水災額賦。 乙酉，晉封貝勒頗羅鼐為郡王。 庚寅，免河南商丘等十州縣水災額賦。 壬辰，哈柳等入覲。 甲午，召車臣汗達瑪林等賜茶。
In the twelfth month, Shandong flood tax was remitted. On bingzi day, Zhejiang transport grain and Henan drought tax were remitted. On wuyin day, Hong Xi faced proposed execution for questioning Antai about Dzungar and imperial affairs. Death sentences were commuted to life imprisonment; Antai was condemned to strangulation. Tax arrears were forgiven in eleven Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Yulin. On guiwei day, Henan flood taxes were remitted in forty-four prefectures and counties including Xiangfu. On yiyou day, Beile Poluonai was promoted to commandery prince. On gengyin day, flood taxes were remitted in ten Henan prefectures and counties including Shangqiu. On renchen day, Haliu and others presented themselves at court. On jiawu day, Tsetsen Khan Damalin and others were summoned and given tea.
56
五年春正月丁未，賑安徽宿州等八州縣，廬江等十州縣衛旱災有差。 丁卯，朝鮮入貢。 辛未，命烏赫圖、巴靈阿護準噶爾人赴藏熬茶。 湖南綏寧苗作亂，命馮光裕等剿之。
In the first month of the fifth year, drought relief was given in Anhui and elsewhere with distinctions. On dingmao day, Korea presented tribute. On xinwei day, Uhetu and Baling'a were ordered to escort Dzungars to Tibet for the tea pilgrimage. Suining Miao rebels in Hunan were ordered suppressed under Feng Guangyu.
57
二月，琉球入貢。 乙亥，命額駙策凌等定各部落接準噶爾游牧邊界。 哈柳歸，召入賜茶，以和議成，嘉獎之。 辛巳，以伊勒慎為綏遠城將軍。 癸未，工部尚書魏廷珍罷。 申諭九卿，毋蹈模稜覆轍。 免山東章丘等六十州縣衛水災額賦。 戊子，免湖北襄陽縣衛上年額賦。 壬辰，免上年安徽宿州雹災、山東滕縣等五縣水災額賦。 戊戌，以韓光基為工部尚書。 辛丑，免湖北漢陽等四縣上年旱災額賦。
In the second month, Ryukyu presented tribute. On yihai day, Celeng and others were ordered to delimit tribal borders against Dzungar pastures. Haliu returned, was summoned and rewarded for securing peace. On xinsi day, Ilershen became Suiyuan City general. On guiwei day, Wei Tingzhen was removed as Minister of Works. The Nine Ministers were warned against equivocating as before. Flood taxes were remitted in sixty Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Zhangqiu. On wuzi day, last year's Hubei taxes were remitted for Xiangyang. On renchen day, last year's taxes were remitted for hail in Suzhou and floods in five Shandong counties. On wuxu day, Han Guangji became Minister of Works. On xinchou day, last year's drought taxes were remitted in four Hubei counties including Hanyang.
58
三月庚戌，以尹繼善為川陝總督，鄂善署刑部尚書。 壬子，免直隸雄縣上年水災額賦。 甲子，免山東霑化等縣場水災額賦。 庚午，湖南栗林、鬼沖各寨苗匪平。
In the third month, Yin Jishan became Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general and Eshan acting Minister of Justice. On renzi day, last year's flood taxes were remitted for Xiong county in Zhili. On jiazi day, flood taxes were remitted at Shandong salterns including Zhanhua. On gengwu day, the Lilin and Guichong Miao bandits in Hunan were pacified.
59
夏四月丙戌，賑兩淮板浦等場災。 戊子，御史褚泰坐受賄論斬。 免陝西葭州、懷遠旱災額賦。 己丑，以那蘇圖為刑部尚書。 甲午，以旱召九卿面諭，直陳政事闕失。 改山東河道為運河道，兗沂曹道為分巡兗、沂、曹三府，管河工。 戊戌，任蘭枝及太常寺卿陶正靖坐朋比，下部嚴議。
In the fourth month, the two Huai salterns including Banpu received disaster relief. On wuzi day, Censor Chu Tai was sentenced to death for bribery. Drought taxes were remitted in Shaanxi's Jiazhou and Huaiyuan. On jichou day, Nasutu became Minister of Justice. On jiawu day, drought led the Emperor to summon the Nine Ministers to report frankly on policy failures. Shandong river offices were reorganized: transport and Yan-Yi-Cao intendant circuits were redefined for river works. On wuxu day, Ren Lanzhi and Tao Zhengjing were sent for severe review for factional collusion.
60
五月甲寅，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。 丙辰，命刑部清理庶獄。 甲子，以楊超曾署兩江總督。 丁卯，諭馮光裕及湖廣提督杜愷剿捕城步、綏寧瑤匪。
In the fifth month, on jiayin day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool. On bingchen day, the Ministry of Justice was ordered to clear backlog cases. On jiazi day, Yang Chaozeng became acting governor-general of the two Jiangs. On dingmao day, Feng Guangyu and Du Kai were ordered to suppress Yao bandits at Chengbu and Suining.
61
六月癸酉，命阿里袞、朱必階查勘山東沂州等處水旱災。 戊寅，命山東、江蘇、安徽捕除蝻子。 召張廣泗來京。 壬辰，賑甘肅秦州水災。 戊戌，福州將軍隆升坐收餽遺，褫職鞫治。
In the sixth month, Aligun and Zhu Bijie were sent to inspect Shandong flood and drought damage. On wuyin day, Shandong, Jiangsu, and Anhui were ordered to eradicate locust nymphs. Zhang Guangsi was recalled to Beijing. On renchen day, Gansu's Qinzhou received flood relief. On wuxu day, Fuzhou general Longsheng was dismissed and tried for taking gifts.
62
閏六月甲辰，廣西義寧苗作亂，諭馬爾泰赴桂林調度兵事。 辛亥，以喀爾吉善為山西巡撫。 命杜愷統率湖南兵至軍前。 乙卯，命張廣泗赴湖南會辦軍務。 甲子，準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零遣使進表。
In the intercalary sixth month, Yining Miao rebels led Ma'ertai to Guilin to direct troops. On xinhai day, Ka'erjishan became Shanxi governor. Du Kai was ordered to bring Hunan troops to the front. On yimao day, Zhang Guangsi was sent to Hunan to direct the campaign jointly. On jiazi day, Galdan Tseren of the Dzungars sent envoys with a memorial.
63
秋七月癸酉，調張渠為湖北巡撫。 以徐士林為江蘇巡撫。 調方顯為廣西巡撫，碩色為四川巡撫，朱定元為山東巡撫。 乙亥，賜噶爾丹策零敕書，諭準噶爾使以阿爾泰山為界，山南遊牧之人，仍居舊地。 設甘肅安西提督，駐哈密。 丁丑，以補熙為綏遠城將軍。 辛巳，詔停今年秋決。 甲申，張廣泗留辦湖南善後。 賑安徽宣城衛飢。 己丑，免安徽鳳陽等十九州縣衛水災、無為等四州縣旱災額賦。 甲午，賑山西徐溝飢。 丁酉，賑甘肅武威等三縣飢。 戊戌，班第奏總兵劉策名等連克長坪各苗寨，獲首倡妖言黎阿蘭等。
In the seventh month, Zhang Qu became Hubei governor. Xu Shilin became Jiangsu governor. Fang Xian, Shuose, and Zhu Dingyuan were made governors of Guangxi, Sichuan, and Shandong. On yihai day, Galdan Tseren was told the Altai would be the border and southern grazers could stay where they were. An Anxi provincial commander was set up in Gansu, based at Hami. On dingchou day, Buxi became Suiyuan City general. On xinsi day, autumn executions were suspended for the year. On jiashen day, Zhang Guangsi stayed in Hunan for post-campaign affairs. Famine relief was given at Anhui's Xuancheng guard. On jichou day, flood and drought taxes were remitted across Anhui including Fengyang and Wuwei. On jiawu day, Shanxi's Xugou received famine relief. On dingyou day, famine relief was given in three Gansu counties including Wuwei. On wuxu day, Bandi reported Liu Ceming's capture of Changping Miao stockades and rebel leader Li Alan.
64
八月己亥朔，廣西宜山縣蠻匪平。 庚子，諭曰：「朕閱江省歲額錢糧雜辦款目，沿自前明，賦役全書亦未編定，官民交受其累，其悉予豁免。 」庚戌，班第奏剿平鹽井口苗匪各寨。 壬戌，上奉皇太后駐南苑。 賑福建永定飢。 免河南中牟等十四州縣水災額賦。 戊辰，譚行義奏安南人立龍彪為王，僭元景興。 癸酉，調楊超曾為吏部尚書，仍署兩江總督，史貽直為兵部尚書，韓光基為刑部尚書，陳世倌為工部尚書。 辛巳，協辦大學士禮部尚書三泰乞休，慰留之。 賑福建上杭飢。 賑浙江餘杭等十六州縣廳衛所水災。 丙戌，江蘇宿遷縣朱家閘河決，命築挑水壩。 丁亥，築江蘇寶山縣吳家濱海塘石壩。 賑陝西葭州等州縣飢。 以王安國為左都御史。 永定河復歸故道。
On the new moon of the eighth month, Yishan Man bandits in Guangxi were pacified. On gengzi day, the Emperor ordered full remission of Jiangsu's Ming-era miscellaneous levies. On gengxu day, Bandi reported the Yanjingkou Miao bandits pacified. On renxu day, the Emperor stayed with the Empress Dowager at the Southern Park. Fujian's Yongding received famine relief. Flood taxes were remitted in fourteen Henan prefectures and counties including Zhongmou. On wuchen day, Tan Xingyi reported Annam had enthroned Long Biao under the reign title Jingxing. On guiyou day, Yang Chaozeng, Shi Yizhi, Han Guangji, and Chen Shiguan received new ministry posts. On xinsi day, Santai's retirement request was declined with encouragement to remain. Fujian's Shanghang received famine relief. Flood relief was given in sixteen Zhejiang prefectures and counties including Yuhang. On bingxu day, a Jiangsu Yellow River breach at Suqian was ordered dammed. On dinghai day, Jiangsu's Baoshan coastal dike gained a stone seawall at Wujia Embankment. Famine relief was given in Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Jiazhou. Wang Anguo became Left Censor-in-chief. The Yongding River was restored to its former channel.
65
冬十月戊戌朔，以常安為漕運總督。 壬寅，上謁泰陵。 乙巳，上還京師。 賑四川綿竹等三縣水災。 甲寅，免甘肅平羅本年水災額賦，仍免寧夏、寧朔半賦。 丙辰，僉都御史劉藻奏請停減圓明園營造，上嘉納之。 賑福建臺灣、諸羅風災。 丁卯，張廣泗奏獲苗匪栗賢宇等，及附瑤匪之戴名揚等，克平溪等寨。
On the new moon of the tenth month, Chang'an became Grain Transport governor-general. On renyin day, the Emperor visited Tailing. On yisi day, the Emperor returned to Beijing. Flood relief was given in three Sichuan counties including Mianzhu. On jiayin day, Gansu flood taxes were remitted at Pingluo and halved at Ningxia and Ningshuo. On bingchen day, Liu Zao's plea to cut Yuanmingyuan construction was approved. Wind-disaster relief was given in Fujian's Taiwan and Zhuluo. On dingmao day, Zhang Guangsi reported capturing Li Xianyu and Dai Mingyang and recovering Pingxi stockades.
66
十一月己巳，以那蘇圖署湖廣總督。 庚午，調來保為刑部尚書，哈達哈為工部尚書。 丙子，楊超曾劾江西巡撫岳濬，命高斌往會鞫之。 己卯，召王謩來京。 命王安國以左都御史管廣東巡撫事。 命阿里袞同高斌勘鞫岳濬。 以劉吳龍為左都御史。 乙酉，命廷臣各舉所知，如湯斌、陸隴其、陳璸、彭鵬諸人。 賑陝西葭州等六州縣飢。
In the eleventh month, Nasutu became acting Huguang governor. On gengwu day, Laibao and Hadaha became Ministers of Justice and Works. On bingzi day, Yue Jun was impeached and Gao Bin was sent to investigate jointly. On jimao day, Wang Mo was summoned to Beijing. Wang Anguo was ordered to act as Guangdong governor in his post as Left Censor-in-chief. Aligun was ordered to assist Gao Bin in trying Yue Jun. Liu Wulong became Left Censor-in-chief. On yiyou day, ministers were told to recommend worthy men such as Tang Bin and Lu Longqi. Famine relief was given in six Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Jiazhou.
67
十二月壬寅，張廣泗進剿湖南城步、綏寧，廣西義寧苗、瑤，悉平之。 免安徽宣城、宣州二縣衛雹災額賦。 免托克托城等處雹災額賦。 壬子，免山東蒲臺逋賦。
In the twelfth month, Zhang Guangsi pacified Hunan and Guangxi Miao and Yao rebels. Hail taxes were remitted in Anhui's Xuancheng and Xuanzhou. Hail taxes were remitted at Tokto city and elsewhere. On renzi day, Shandong tax arrears were forgiven at Putai.
68
六年春正月甲戌，裁安西總兵，設提督。 丙子，免福建閩縣等五縣逋賦。 甲申，命鄂爾泰、訥親會同孫嘉淦、顧琮勘視永定河工。 命參贊大臣阿岱駐烏里雅蘇台。 以慶泰為北路軍營參贊大臣。 戊子，免霸州、雄縣額賦。 甲午，命班第仍在軍機處行走。
In the first month of the sixth year, Anxi's regional commander was replaced by a provincial commander. On bingzi day, tax arrears were forgiven in five Fujian counties including Min. On jiashen day, E'ertai, Neqin, Sun Jiagan, and Gu Cong were sent to inspect Yongding River works. Adai was posted as coordinating minister at Uliassutai. Qingtai became northern-route army coordinating minister. On wuzi day, Bazhou and Xiongxian quota taxes were waived. On jiawu day, Ban Di kept his post at the Grand Council.
69
二月，御史叢洞請暫息行圍，上以飭兵懷遠之意訓之。 丙午，以完顏偉為南河副總河。 免湖北鍾祥等四縣雹水災額賦。 甲寅，免陝西葭州等三州縣雹災額賦。 庚申，增設山西歸化城分巡道。
In the second month, Cong Dong asked to pause the hunt; the emperor rebuked him for missing its purpose of training troops and winning the frontier. On bingwu day, Wanyan Wei became deputy South River director. Hubei Zhongxiang and three other counties received hail-flood tax relief. On jiayin day, Jiazhou and two other Shaanxi districts received hail tax relief. On gengshen day, Shanxi's Guihuacheng circuit intendant post was created.
70
三月壬申，命侍郎楊嗣璟往山西會鞫山西學政喀爾欽賄賣生員之獄。 甲申，以御史仲永檀劾鄂善受賄，命怡親王等鞫之。 鄂善褫職逮問。 辛卯，擢仲永檀為僉都御史。
In the third month, Yang Sijing was sent to Shanxi to try Kaerqin's bribery-for-licentiate case. On jiashen day, Prince Yi and others were assigned to try E Shan after Zhong Yongtan's bribery charge. E Shan was dismissed and taken into custody. On xinmao day, Zhong Yongtan rose to censor-in-chief.
71
夏四月乙未朔，大學士趙國麟乞休，不允。 免江蘇豐縣等十州縣衛水災、蟲災、民屯蘆課。 甲辰，免順天直隸霸州等十州縣上年水災額賦。 以慶復署兩廣總督，張允隨署雲貴總督。 己酉，賜鄂善自盡。
In the fourth month, Zhao Guolin's retirement request was denied. Jiangsu Fengxian and nine other districts received flood, locust, and reed-tax relief. On jiachen day, ten Zhili districts including Bazhou received last year's flood tax relief. Qing Fu took acting charge of Liangguang; Zhang Yunshi of Yungui. On jiyou day, E Shan was allowed to kill himself.
72
五月戊寅，免福建臺灣逋賦。 賑江西興國等縣水災，貴州仁懷、平越水災。
In the fifth month, Fujian Taiwan tax arrears were forgiven. Flood relief went to Jiangxi Xingguo and other counties and to Guizhou Renhuai and Pingyue.
73
六月甲午朔，免陝西葭州等六州縣上年水災額賦。 丙申，江蘇巡撫徐士林給假省親，調陳大受署之。 改張楷為安徽巡撫。 庚子，命王安國勘廣東征糧積弊。 乙巳，以御史李剗劾甘肅匿災，命會同尹繼善勘之。 己酉，浙江巡撫盧焯解任，命德沛及副都統汪扎勒鞫之。 賑安徽宿州等十二州縣水災，江蘇山陽等州縣水災。 趙國麟以薦舉非人，降調。
In the sixth month, six Shaanxi districts including Jiazhou received last year's flood tax relief. On bingshen day, Xu Shilin went on family leave; Chen Dashou acted as Jiangsu governor. Zhang Kai became Anhui governor. On gengzi day, Wang Anguo was sent to probe Guangdong campaign grain abuses. On yisi day, Li Gang's charge of concealed Gansu famine sent him with Yin Jishan to investigate. On jiyou day, Lu Chao was dismissed; Depu and Wang Zhale were to investigate him. Flood relief went to twelve Anhui districts and to Jiangsu Shanyang and others. Zhao Guolin was reduced in rank for bad nominations.
74
秋七月，免江蘇蘇州等府屬逋賦。 甲子，喀爾欽處斬。 丙子，薩哈諒論斬。 戊寅，甘肅巡撫元展成以御史胡定劾，解任，命副都統新柱往會尹繼善鞫之。 癸未，詔停今年秋決。 戊子，上初舉秋獮。 奉皇太后幸避暑山莊，免經過額賦十分之三。 自是每年皆如之，減行圍所過州縣額賦。 辛卯，賑江西武寧等二縣水災。 壬辰，上至古北口閱兵。 賑廣東永安、歸善二縣飢。
In the seventh month, Jiangsu Suzhou and other districts received arrears tax relief. On jiazi day, Kaerqin was beheaded. On bingzi day, Sahaliang received the death penalty. On wuyin day, Yuan Zhancheng left office over Hu Ding's charge; Xinzhu joined Yin Jishan to try the case. On guiwei day, autumn executions were suspended. On wuzi day, the emperor opened the autumn hunt. Traveling with the empress dowager to the summer retreat, he cut route taxes by thirty percent. Thereafter counties on the hunt route received annual tax reductions. On xinmao day, Jiangxi Wuning and another county received flood relief. On renchen day, the emperor inspected troops at Gubeikou. Guangdong Yong'an and Guishan received famine relief.
75
八月癸巳，賑安徽宿州等十九州縣衛水災。 庚子，上駐蹕張三營。 辛丑，上行圍。 賑江蘇山陽等十八州縣、莞瀆等場水災。 己酉，召楊超曾回京。 調那蘇圖為兩江總督，孫嘉淦為湖廣總督。 以高斌為直隸總督，完顏偉為江南河道總督。 裁直隸河道總督，命高斌兼理直隸河務。 辛亥，召寧古塔將軍吉黨阿來京，以鄂爾達代之。
In the eighth month, nineteen Anhui districts including Suzhou received flood relief. On gengzi day, the court halted at Zhangsanying. On xinchou day, the emperor held a battue hunt. Jiangsu Shanyang and seventeen other districts and the Guandu pans received flood relief. On jiyou day, Yang Chaoeng was recalled to Beijing. Nasutu became Liangjiang governor-general; Sun Jiagan Huguang governor-general. Gao Bin took Zhili; Wanyan Wei took Jiangnan waterways. Zhili's waterworks governor-general was abolished; Gao Bin added Zhili river duties. On xinhai day, Jidang'a left Ningguta; E'erda succeeded him.
76
九月癸亥朔，以陳宏謀為甘肅巡撫。 乙丑，上奉皇太后回駐避暑山莊。 賑廣東南海等二十六州縣廳飢。 上奉皇太后回蹕。 壬申，授王恕福建巡撫，楊錫紱廣西巡撫。 甲戌，調陳宏謀為江西巡撫，黃廷桂為甘肅巡撫。 免江蘇、安徽乾隆三四年被災漕糧。 己卯，調韓光基為工部尚書。 以劉吳龍為刑部尚書。 辛巳，原任江蘇巡撫徐士林卒。 授陳大受江蘇巡撫，張楷安徽巡撫。 賑福建福清等八縣及長福等鎮營飢。 丁亥，以劉統勛為左都御史。
In the ninth month, Chen Hongmou became Gansu governor. On yichou day, the emperor returned with the empress dowager to the summer retreat. Guangdong Nanhai and twenty-five other districts received famine relief. The emperor escorted the empress dowager back toward the capital. On renshen day, Wang Shu took Fujian; Yang Xizhao Guangxi. On jiaxu day, Chen Hongmou went to Jiangxi; Huang Tinggui to Gansu. Jiangsu and Anhui disaster-struck grain transport levies from years 3-4 were waived. On jimao day, Han Guangji became minister of works. Liu Wulong became minister of punishments. On xinsi day, former governor Xu Shilin died. Chen Dashou took Jiangsu; Zhang Kai Anhui. Fujian Fuqing and seven other counties plus Changfu garrisons received famine relief. On dinghai day, Liu Tongxun became left censor-in-chief.
77
冬十月庚子，賑廣東瓊山等二十四州縣颶災。 丁未，賑安徽宿州等三十一州縣衛水災，並免宿州等三州縣額賦漕糧。 己酉，賑甘肅靈州等處飢。 丙辰，賑熱河四旗丁水災。
In the tenth month, twenty-four Guangdong districts including Qiongshan received typhoon relief. On dingwei day, thirty-one Anhui districts received flood relief; three including Suzhou also got tax and grain remissions. On jiyou day, Gansu Lingzhou and other places received famine relief. On bingchen day, Rehe's four banners received flood relief.
78
十一月甲子，賑兩淮灶戶飢。 乙丑，南掌國王島孫遣使入貢。 丙寅，賑甘肅平番等十四州縣雹水災。 己巳，御史李剗陳奏甘肅飢饉情形不實，部議革職。 上曰：「與其懲言官而開諱災之端，寧從寬假以廣耳目。 」命革職留任。 戊寅，免江蘇山陽等十五州縣衛水災額賦。 賑句容等三十四州縣衛飢。 丙戌，皇太后五旬聖壽節，御慈寧宮，上率諸王大臣等行慶賀禮。
In the eleventh month, Lianghuai salt-workers received famine relief. On yichou day, Nan Zhang paid tribute. On bingyin day, fourteen Gansu districts including Pingfan received hail-flood relief. On jisi day, Li Gang's Gansu famine report was found false and the ministry sought his dismissal. The emperor said leniency toward censors was better than encouraging disaster concealment. Li Gang was demoted but kept on duty. On wuyin day, fifteen Jiangsu districts including Shanyang received flood tax relief. Jurong and thirty-three other districts received famine relief. On bingxu day, the emperor led court congratulations at Cining for the empress dowager's fiftieth birthday.
79
十二月乙未，劉統勛請停張廷玉近屬升轉，減訥親所管事務，上嘉之。 丙申，大學士張廷玉請解部務，不許。 辛丑，免甘肅武威等二縣五年被水額賦。 賑江蘇江浦等州縣旱災。 免湖南湘鄉等二縣被水額賦。 乙巳，免浙江仁和等十九州縣本年額賦。 丁未，免山東歷城等十六州縣衛旱災額賦。 庚戌，免甘肅永昌等三縣旱災額賦。 琉球入貢。 調常安為浙江巡撫，顧琮為漕運總督。 命劉統勛往浙江會勘海塘。 賑浙江嵊縣等十七州縣、仁和等場水旱災。
In the twelfth month, Liu Tongxun sought curbs on Zhang Tingyu's kin and Neqin offices and won praise. On bingshen day, Zhang Tingyu's request to quit ministry work was denied. On xinchou day, two Gansu counties including Wuwei received five years of flood tax relief. Jiangsu Jiangpu and other districts received drought relief. Hunan Xiangxiang and another county received flood tax relief. On yisi day, nineteen Zhejiang districts including Renhe received this year's tax relief. On dingwei day, sixteen Shandong districts including Licheng received drought tax relief. On gengxu day, three Gansu counties including Yongchang received drought tax relief. Ryukyu sent tribute. Chang An took Zhejiang; Gu Cong the grain transport command. Liu Tongxun was sent to Zhejiang to inspect sea dikes. Zhejiang Shengxian and sixteen other districts plus Renhe pans received flood-drought relief.
80
七年春正月壬戌，調史貽直為吏部尚書，任蘭枝為兵部尚書。 以趙國麟為禮部尚書。 庚午，定綏遠城、右衛、歸化城土默特、察哈爾共挑兵四千名，內札薩克首隊兵四千五百名、二隊兵六千五百名，援應北路軍營，並於額爾德尼昭沿途置駝馬備用。 戊寅，以那克素三十九部番民備辦準噶爾進藏官兵駝馬，免本年額賦。 甲申，賑安徽鳳陽、潁州二府，泗州一州屬飢民。 庚寅，準噶爾入貢。
In spring of year 7, Shi Yizhi took personnel; Ren Lanzhi war. Zhao Guolin became minister of rites. On gengwu day, troops and camels were arranged to reinforce the northern camp along the Erdeni Zhao route. On wuyin day, thirty-nine Nakusu tribes were tax-exempt for supplying the Tibet campaign. On jiashen day, Fengyang, Yingzhou, and Su Prefecture received famine relief. On gengyin day, the Zungars sent tribute.
81
二月辛卯朔，上詣泰陵。 乙未，上謁泰陵。 是日，回蹕。 丙申，朝鮮入貢。 戊戌，上幸南苑行圍。 己亥，琉球入貢。 己酉，禮部尚書趙國麟乞休，不允。 乙卯，以吉黨阿為歸化城都統。
In the second month, the emperor set out for Tailing. On yiwei day, the emperor worshipped at Tailing. The court returned that same day. On bingshen day, Korea sent tribute. On wuxu day, the emperor hunted at the Southern Park. On jihai day, Ryukyu sent tribute again. On jiyou day, Zhao Guolin's retirement plea was denied. On yimao day, Jidang'a became Guihuacheng commander.
82
三月庚申朔，上憂旱，申命求言，並飭九卿大臣體國盡職。 丁卯，命大學士、九卿、督、撫舉如馬周、陽城者為言官。 乙亥，以旱命刑部清理庶獄，各省如之。 以晏斯盛為山東巡撫。 辛巳，準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零遣使吹納木喀等奉表貢方物，乞勿限年貿易。 壬午，以噶爾丹策零表奏狡詐，諭西北兩路軍營大臣加意防之。 戊子，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。 以兩江總督那蘇圖辦賑遺漏，切責之。
In the third month, on the new moon of gengshen, drought led the Emperor to solicit advice and urge ministers to their duties. On dingmao day, ministers were told to recommend outspoken officials like Ma Zhou and Yang Cheng. On yihai day, drought led to orders to clear prisons nationwide. Yan Sisheng became Shandong governor. On xinsi day, Galdan Tseren sent Chuinamuka and others with tribute, seeking unrestricted annual trade. On renwu day, Galdan Tseren's deceitful memorial led to tighter frontier vigilance. On wuzi day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool. Naxitu was sharply rebuked for gaps in Two-Jiangs famine relief.
83
夏四月庚寅朔，準噶爾貢使吹納木喀等入覲。 裁八溝、獨石口副都統各一，增天津副都統一。 以古北口提督管獨石口外臺站。 免河南永城等三縣上年被水額賦。 甲午，賜金甡等三百二十三人進士及第出身有差。 調德沛為兩江總督，那蘇圖為閩浙總督。 乙未，撥安徽賑銀三十萬兩有奇，並准採買湖廣米備糶。 辛丑，賑安徽宿州等州縣衛水災。 甲辰，賜準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零敕書，申誡以追論舊事，屢違定約，並諭將此次奏請貿易、改道噶斯等事停止，仍賞賚如例。 甲寅，除河南洧川等十一縣水沖地賦。 免福建福清等七縣颶災額賦。 丙辰，刑部尚書劉吳龍卒，以張照為刑部尚書。
In the fourth month, Dzungar envoys Chuinamuka and others were received. Vice commanders at Bagou and Dushikou were cut; Tianjin gained one. The Gubeikou commander took charge of stations beyond Dushikou. Henan's Yongcheng and two other counties were excused last year's flood taxes. On jiawu day, Jin Shen and 323 others received jinshi degrees with graded ranks. Depei became Two-Jiangs governor-general; Naxitu Min-Zhe governor-general. On yiwei day, over 300,000 taels of Anhui relief silver were issued and Huguang rice purchases approved. On xinchou day, Anhui flood victims in Suzhou and elsewhere were relieved. On jiachen day, Galdan Tseren received an imperial letter rebuking broken agreements and refusing trade and route requests while keeping usual gifts. On jiayin day, eleven Henan counties including Weichuan were excused flood-washed land tax. Fujian's Fuqing and six other counties were excused typhoon taxes. On bingchen day, Liu Wulong died; Zhang Zhao became Minister of Justice.
84
五月己未朔，以順天、保定等八府，易州等五州缺雨，命停徵新舊錢糧。 定移駐滿兵屯墾拉林、阿勒楚喀事宜，設副都統，以巴靈阿為之。 戊辰，以御史胡定劾，寢趙弘恩補刑部侍郎之命。 癸酉，定雩祭典禮，御制樂章。 免江蘇沛縣昭陽湖水沈田畝額賦。 丙戌，禁奏章稱蒙古為「夷人」。 以琉球國王資送江南遭風難民，嘉獎之。 張允隨奏猛遮界外孟艮酋長召賀罕被逐，遁入緬甸。
In the fifth month, drought in Shuntian, Baoding, and other areas led to suspension of tax collection. Rules were set for Manchu farming colonies at Lalin and Alechuka; Baling'a became vice commander. On wuchen day, Hu Ding's impeachment blocked Zhao Hong'en's Justice vice ministership. On guiyou day, rain-prayer rites were codified with new imperial hymns. Pei County's Zhaoyang Lake flood fields were excused grain tax. On bingxu day, memorials could no longer call Mongols "barbarians." Ryukyu was commended for aiding Jiangnan shipwreck survivors. Zhang Yunsui reported Menggen chief Zhao Hehan driven out and fled to Burma.
85
六月甲寅，諭督撫董率州縣經畫地利。 戊申，訓飭地方官實心經理平糶。
In the sixth month, governors were told to guide counties in land planning. On wushen day, officials were urged to run fair-price grain sales conscientiously.
86
秋七月己未，命資送日本遭風難民歸國。 免廣西梧州等三府屬逋賦。 辛酉，除山西繁峙、廣西武緣荒地額賦。 乙丑，禮部尚書趙國麟乞休，上責其矯飾，褫職。 調任蘭枝為禮部尚書，陳德華為兵部尚書，徐本兼管戶部尚書。 丙寅，命大學士鄂爾泰兼領侍衛內大臣。 命賑江蘇山陽等州縣水災。 命撫恤江蘇阜寧等州縣水災。 癸未，命高斌、周學健往江南查辦災賑、水利。 甲申，賑湖北漢川、襄陽等州縣衛水雹災，並停徵額賦。 丙戌，賑江蘇江浦等十八州縣衛、安徽臨淮等州縣衛。 撫恤江西興國等州縣、浙江淳安等州縣、湖南醴陵等八州縣、山東嶧縣等十州縣衛、甘肅狄道等四州縣廳災民。
In the seventh month, Japanese castaways were sent home with aid. Guangxi's Wuzhou and two other prefectures were excused tax arrears. On xinyou day, wasteland tax was cut in Fanshi and Wuyuan. On yichou day, Zhao Guolin's retirement plea brought rebuke and dismissal. Ren Lanzhi, Chen Dehua, and Xu Ben received new ministerial posts. On bingyin day, Ortai was made interior palace guard commander as well. Jiangsu flood victims in Shanyang and elsewhere were ordered relieved. Funing and other Jiangsu flood areas were ordered comforted. On guiwei day, Gao Bin and Zhou Xuejian were sent to audit Jiangnan relief and rivers. On jiashen day, Hubei hail-flood areas were relieved and taxes suspended. On bingxu day, Jiangsu and Anhui flood areas received relief. Disaster victims in Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Hunan, Shandong, and Gansu were comforted.
87
八月戊子，江南黃、淮交漲，命疆吏拯救災黎，毋拘常例。 訓飭慎重軍政。 撥江蘇、安徽賑銀二百五十萬兩有奇。 庚寅，免江蘇、安徽被水地方本年額賦。 辛卯，定皇后親蠶典禮。 戊戌，免直隸、江蘇、安徽、福建、甘肅、廣東等省雍正十三年逋賦，並免江南、浙江未完雍正十三年漕項。 庚子，諭河南等省撫恤江南流民。 壬寅，上奉皇太后幸南苑，上行圍。 癸卯，賑江西興國水災。 乙巳，上奉皇太后幸晾鷹臺閱圍。
In the eighth month, Jiangnan's Huang-Huai floods led to orders to save victims beyond routine rules. Officials were admonished to handle military affairs carefully. Over 2.5 million taels of Jiangsu and Anhui relief silver were issued. On gengyin day, this year's grain tax was cut in flooded Jiangsu and Anhui. On xinmao day, the empress's silkworm ceremony was codified. On wuxu day, Yongzheng 13 arrears were cut in several provinces and Jiangnan-Zhejiang transport dues. On gengzi day, provinces were told to aid Jiangnan refugees. On renyin day, the Emperor took the Empress Dowager to the Southern Park and hunted. On guimao day, Xingguo flood victims were relieved. On yisi day, the Empress Dowager watched the hunt at Laying-Hawk Terrace.
88
九月丁巳朔，撥江蘇運山東截留漕米十萬石，備淮、徐、鳳、潁各屬賑糶。 賑湖北潛江等十州縣水災。 辛酉，免廣東崖州等二州縣風災額賦。 免安徽鳳、潁、泗三府州本年水災地方漕賦，不成災者折征之。 賑湖南湘陰等九縣水災。 丁卯，上詣東陵。 庚午，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵。 免江蘇山陽等二十一州縣本年被水漕賦。 壬申，上幸盤山。 賑恤江蘇、安徽災銀二百九十萬兩、米穀二百二十萬石各有奇。 命再撥鄰省銀一百萬兩備明春接濟。 乙亥，上幸棽髻山。 戊寅，上回蹕。
In the ninth month, 100,000 shi of detained transport grain was set aside for Huai-Xu relief sales. Ten Hubei prefectures and counties including Qianjiang received flood relief. On xinyou day, Yazhou and one other Guangdong county were excused wind taxes. Anhui transport tax was cut in flood zones; partial disaster areas paid in commutation. Nine Hunan counties including Xiangyin received flood relief. On dingmao day, the Emperor went to the Eastern Tombs. On gengwu day, the Emperor visited Zhaoxi, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, and Jingling. Twenty-one flooded Jiangsu counties including Shanyang were excused transport tax. On renshen day, the Emperor went to Mount Pan. Jiangsu and Anhui received over 2.9 million taels of silver and 2.2 million shi of grain in relief. Another million taels from neighboring provinces was ordered for spring relief. On yihai day, the Emperor went to Fenji Mountain. On wuyin day, the Emperor returned to the capital.
89
冬十月丙戌，撥山東、河南明年運漕米各五萬石備江南賑，仍由直隸赴古北口外如數採買補運。 己丑，免山東歷城等十九州縣旱災額賦。 庚寅，命江南截留癸亥年漕糧二十萬石，仍撥山東漕糧二十萬石，河南倉米二十萬石，運江南備賑。 癸巳，浙江提督裴鉽等以侵欺褫職鞫治。 壬辰，賑江蘇山陽等二十八州縣衛飢。 甲午，命清理滯獄。 乙未，命撥山東沿河倉穀十萬石運江南備賑。 丁酉，賑安徽鳳陽二十四州縣衛水災。 甲辰，朝鮮國王李昑表謝國人金時宗等越境犯法，屢荷寬典。 上曰：「此朕柔遠之恩。 若恃有寬典，犯法滋多，非朕保全外籓之本意。 王其嚴加約束，毋俾干紀。 」以塞楞額為陝西巡撫。 己酉，賑河南永城等十三州縣飢。 辛亥，上詣順懿密太妃宮問疾。 壬子，賑江蘇山陽等七州縣衛水災。
In the tenth month, Shandong and Henan each gave 50,000 shi of next year's grain for Jiangnan relief, with Gubeikou purchases to replenish. On jichou day, nineteen drought-struck Shandong counties including Licheng were excused tax. On gengyin day, 200,000 shi of detained guihai transport grain plus Shandong and Henan grain were sent to Jiangnan. On guisi day, Pei Yue and others were dismissed and tried for graft. On renchen day, twenty-eight Jiangsu areas including Shanyang received famine relief. On jiawu day, delayed court cases were ordered cleared. On yiwei day, 100,000 shi of Shandong river grain was sent to Jiangnan. On dingyou day, twenty-four Fengyang-area units received flood relief. On jiachen day, King Yeongjo thanked the court for clemency toward border violators led by Kim Sijong. The Emperor said, "This is My gracious policy toward distant peoples. If you rely on repeated pardons and offenses multiply, that is not how I mean to protect vassal states. You must strictly restrain them and not let them break the law. Saileng'e became Shaanxi governor. On jiyou day, thirteen Henan areas including Yongcheng received famine relief. On xinhai day, the Emperor inquired after Imperial Noble Consort Shunyi's illness. On renyin day, seven Jiangsu flood areas including Shanyang were relieved.
90
