十一月丙辰朔，大學士等奏纂輯明史體例。 上曰：「諸卿所見與朕意同。 繼春秋之翼道，昭來茲之鑒觀，我君臣其共勉之。 」賑湖北漢川等十二州縣水災飢。 戊午，賑浙江瑞安等縣廳場、湖南湘陰等九縣水災。 庚申，福建漳浦縣會匪戕殺知縣，命嚴治之。 壬戌，賑山東膠州十州縣衛水災。 癸亥，賑甘肅狄道等州縣水雹災。 乙亥，命持法寬嚴，務歸平允。 命陳世倌會同高斌查勘江南水利。 戊寅，諭明春奉皇太后詣盛京謁陵。 庚辰，以初定齋宮禮，是日詣齋宮。
In the eleventh month, Grand Secretaries reported principles for compiling the Ming History. The Emperor said, "Your views accord with My mind. Follow the Spring and Autumn in aiding the Way and set a mirror for posterity—let us strive together. Relief was given for flood famine in twelve Hubei counties including Hanchuan. On wuwu day, Zhejiang and Hunan flood areas including Ruian and Xiangyin were relieved. On gengshen day, after Zhangpu magistrates were killed by a secret society, harsh punishment was ordered. On renxu day, ten Shandong flood areas including Jiaozhou were relieved. On guihai day, Didao and other Gansu hail-flood areas were relieved. On yihai day, officials were told to apply law with balanced severity. Chen Shiguan was ordered to survey Jiangnan rivers with Gao Bin. On wuyin day, a spring visit to Mukden tombs with the Empress Dowager was announced. On gengchen day, with the new fasting palace rite in place, the Emperor went there.
91
十二月丙戌朔，賑山東濟寧等七州縣衛飢。 丁亥，命考試薦舉科道人才。 周學健舉三人皆同鄉，諭飭之。 命左副都御史仲永檀會同周學健查賑。 壬辰，上奉皇太后幸瀛臺。 丙子，仲永檀、鄂容安以漏泄機密，逮交內務府慎刑司，命莊親王等鞫治。 免福建尤溪等四縣荒田溢額銀。 己亥，召安徽巡撫張楷來京，調喀爾吉善代之。 命寬鄂爾泰黨庇仲永檀罪。 免直隸薊州等三州縣水災額賦。 丁未，撥運吉林烏拉倉糧接濟齊齊哈爾等處旱災。 庚戌，賑奉天承德等五州縣飢。 免山東膠州等十州縣衛水災額賦。 辛亥，調完顏偉為河東河道總督，白鍾山為江南河道總督。 乙卯，諭曰：「江南水災地畝涸出，耕種刻不容緩。 疆吏其勸災民愛護田牛，或給貲飼養，毋得以細事置之。 」
In the twelfth month, seven Shandong famine areas including Jining were relieved. On dinghai day, recommended censorate and other talents were ordered examined. Zhou Xuejian was rebuked for recommending three fellow-townsmen. Zhong Yongtan was ordered to inspect relief with Zhou Xuejian. On renchen day, the Emperor took the Empress Dowager to Yingtai. On bingzi day, Zhong Yongtan and E Rong'an were arrested for leaking secrets and tried under Prince Zhuang. Youxi and three other Fujian counties were excused wasteland overflow tax. On jihai day, Zhang Kai was recalled from Anhui and Karjishan took his place. Ortai's party was granted leniency in shielding Zhong Yongtan. Flood taxes were remitted in three Zhili districts including Jizhou. On dingwei day, Jilin grain was sent to drought-stricken Qiqihar and elsewhere. On gengxu day, famine relief reached five Fengtian districts including Chengde. Flood taxes were remitted in ten Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Jiaozhou. On xinhai day, Wan Yan Wei took Hedong river conservancy and Bai Zhongshan Jiangnan. On yimao day, an edict urged urgent spring planting in Jiangnan's flood districts. Officials were told to protect or subsidize oxen and not treat the matter lightly. The edict closed.
92
八年春正月丁巳，免鄂容安發軍臺，命仍在上書房行走。 仲永檀死於獄。 召孫嘉淦來京。 以阿爾賽為湖廣總督。 甲子，陳世倌等奏修江蘇淮、徐、揚、海，安徽鳳、潁、泗各屬河道水利，下大學士鄂爾泰等大臣議行之。 己卯，命軍機大臣徐本、班第、那彥泰隨往盛京。 辛巳，召參贊大臣阿岱、塔爾瑪回京，以拉布敦、烏爾登代之。 壬辰，內閣學士李紱致仕陛辭，以慎終如始對，賜詩嘉之。 辛卯，以考選御史，杭世駿策言內滿外漢，忤旨褫職。 調劉於義為山西巡撫。 命孫嘉淦署福建巡撫。 丙申，命尹繼善署兩江總督，協同白鍾山料理河務。 癸卯，命侍講鄧時敏、給事中倪國璉為鳳、潁、泗宣諭化導使，編修塗逢震、御史徐以升為淮、徐、揚、海宣諭化導使。 乙巳，免湖北漢川等十一州縣衛水災額賦。 准趙國麟回籍。 癸丑，遣和親王弘晝代祀先農壇、用中和韶樂，與上親祭同，著為例。 賑山東滕縣等六州縣飢。 庚午，調喀爾吉善為山東巡撫，晏斯盛為湖北巡撫，范璨為安徽巡撫。 丙子，上詣壽祺皇太妃宮問疾。
In the first month of the eighth year, E Rong'an was spared the courier-station exile and kept at the Upper Study. Zhong Yongtan died in jail. Sun Jiagan was called to Beijing. A Erse became Huguang governor-general. On jiazi day, Chen Shilu and others proposed Huai-Xu-Yang-Hai and Feng-Ying-Si river repairs; Ortai and colleagues were to decide. On jimao day, Xu Ben, Bandi, and Nayantai were ordered to Mukden with the court. On xinsi day, Adai and Ta'erma returned to Beijing; Labudun and Wulden replaced them. On renchen day, retiring academician Li Fu answered "end as you began" and received an imperial poem. On xinmao day, Hang Shijun lost his post after a censor-selection essay urging Manchu priority. Liu Yuyi became Shanxi governor. Sun Jiagan was told to act as Fujian governor. On bingshen day, Yin Jishan acted as Liangjiang governor-general with Bai Zhongshan on river works. On guimao day, Deng Shimin and Ni Guolian were named Feng-Ying-Si commissioners; Tu Fengzhen and Xu Yisheng Huai-Xu-Yang-Hai commissioners. On yisi day, flood taxes were remitted in eleven Hubei prefectures, counties, and guards including Hanchuan. Zhao Guolin was allowed to go home. On guichou day, Prince He offered the First Farmer sacrifice with full imperial music, setting a precedent. Six Shandong districts including Tengxian received famine relief. On gengwu day, Karjishan took Shandong, Yan Sisheng Hubei, and Fan Can Anhui. On bingzi day, the Emperor visited Dowager Shouqi to ask after her health.
93
夏四月甲申朔，壽祺皇太妃薨，輟朝十日。 上欲持服，莊親王等祈免。 訓飭九卿勤事。 申命各督撫陳奏屬員賢否。 乙酉，上詣壽祺皇貴太妃宮致奠。 辛卯，命奉宸苑試行區田法。 丁酉，賑安徽鳳陽六府州屬水災飢。 免湖北襄陽等三縣水災額賦。 庚子，裁江蘇海防道，設淮徐海道，駐徐州府。 以蘇松巡道兼管塘工。 揚州府隸常鎮道。 原設淮徐、淮揚二道專管河工。
In the fourth month, Dowager Shouqi died and court sat in mourning ten days. The Emperor wanted full mourning; Prince Zhuang and others begged him off. The Nine Ministers were warned to work diligently. Governors were again told to report on their subordinates. On yiyou day, the Emperor offered libations for Noble Dowager Shouqi. On xinmao day, the Imperial Parks were told to test checkerboard-field farming. On dingyou day, six Fengyang prefectures received flood and famine relief. Flood taxes were remitted in three Hubei counties including Xiangyang. On gengzi day, Jiangsu coastal defense was abolished and Huai-Xu-Hai circuit set at Xuzhou. Su-Song surveillance also took charge of embankment works. Yangzhou was placed under Chang-Zhen circuit. Huai-Xu and Huai-Yang circuits had formerly handled river works alone.
94
閏四月甲寅朔，琉球入貢。 丁巳，御試翰林、詹事等官，擢王會汾等三員為一等，餘各升黜有差。 辛酉，免河南鄭州等十三州縣本年水災額賦。 甲戌，除江蘇吳江等二縣坍沒田盪額賦。
In the intercalary fourth month, Ryukyu sent tribute. On dingsi day, the Emperor tested Hanlin and Household officials; Wang Huifen and three others topped the list. On xinyou day, this year's flood taxes were remitted in thirteen Henan districts including Zhengzhou. On jiaxu day, taxes on lost Jiangsu fields and shoals including Wujiang were removed.
95
五月癸未朔，諭鑾輿巡幸，令扈從護軍等加意約束，不得踐踏田禾。 乙酉，御史沈懋華以進呈經史講義召見，已去，下部嚴議。 丁亥，命河南停徵上年被水地方錢糧。 己亥，免江蘇山陽等十三州縣牙稅。 免臨清商民運徵米船料及銅補商補。 辛丑，賑山東歷城等十八州縣衛飢。 丙午，以碩色為河南巡撫，紀山為四川巡撫。 戊申，調慶復為川陝總督。 以馬爾泰為兩廣總督。 授張允隨為雲南總督，兼管巡撫事。 辛酉，蘇祿國王麻喊末阿稟漻寧表請三年一修職貢，命仍遵五年舊例。
In the fifth month, an edict told escort guards on tour not to trample crops. On yiyou day, Shen Maohua, summoned for a classics lecture but gone, was referred for strict punishment. On dinghai day, Henan was told to stop collecting last year's levies from flood districts. On jihai day, transit taxes were remitted in thirteen Jiangsu districts including Shanyang. Linqing boat charges and merchant copper levies were remitted. On xinchou day, eighteen Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Licheng received famine relief. On bingwu day, Suose took Henan and Jishan Sichuan. On wushen day, Qing Fu became Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general. Maertai became Liangguang governor-general. Zhang Yunshi was made Yunnan governor-general with governorship duties. On xinyou day, Sulu's king asked for triennial tribute but was told to keep the five-year schedule.
96
六月壬子朔，御史陳仁請以經史考試翰詹，不宜用詩賦，上嘉之。 甲寅，改南掌為十年一貢。 乙卯，除江蘇沛縣水沈地賦。 丙辰，以旱求言。 戊午，命阿里袞暫署河南巡撫。 丁卯，以御史胡定劾湖南巡撫許容一案，究出督撫誣陷扶同，予敘。 壬申，諭督撫率屬重農。
In the sixth month, Chen Ren urged classics over poetry in Hanlin exams and was praised. On jiayin day, Nanzhang tribute was set at once in ten years. On yimao day, taxes on submerged Peixian land were removed. On bingchen day, drought prompted the Emperor to seek memorials. On wuwu day, Arigge was told to act as Henan governor. On dingmao day, Hu Ding's case against Xu Rong exposed collusive framing by governors; punishments followed. On renshen day, governors were told to lead their staffs in honoring farming.
97
秋七月乙酉，上詣順懿密太妃宮問疾。 丙戌，以安南不靖，擾及雲南開化都霙廠，命張允隨等嚴防之。 開化鎮總兵賽都請討安南，不許。 戊子，上奉皇太后由熱河詣盛京謁陵，免經過之直隸、奉天地方錢糧。 撥通倉米四十萬石賑直隸旱災。 壬辰，免山東歷城等十六州縣衛旱災額賦。 乙未，停今年勾決。 上奉皇太后駐避暑山莊。 丙申，除福建連江等二縣水沖地賦。 己亥，上奉皇太后詣盛京。 癸卯，上行圍於永安莽喀。 乙巳，上行圍於愛里。 丙午，上行圍於錫拉諾海。 命嚴除州縣徵漕坐倉之弊。 戊申，免直隸滄州被雹灶戶額賦。 上奉皇太后駐蹕嗎嗎塔喇。 己酉，上行圍，至己卯皆如之。 嚴督撫等漏泄密奏之禁。 賑湖北興國等三州縣水災，並免額賦。 癸亥，萬壽節，上詣皇太后行幄行禮。 御行幄，扈從諸王以下大臣官員暨蒙古王以下各官慶賀。 賜諸王、大臣、蒙古王等宴。 甲子，上駐蹕巴雅爾圖塔剌。 乙丑，上行圍。 戊辰，上行圍。 壬申，上駐蹕伊克淖爾，上行圍，至丙子如之。 甲戌，賑四川西昌水災。 定直隸被旱州縣賑恤事宜。 賑廣東始興等十六州縣水災。 己卯，上行圍於巴彥，親射殪虎。
In the seventh month, the Emperor visited Dowager Shunyi to ask after her health. On bingxu day, unrest in Annam reaching Yunnan's Kaihua mine led Zhang Yunshi and others to tighten defenses. Saidou's request to attack Annam was denied. On wuzi day, traveling from Rehe to Mukden with the Empress Dowager, the Emperor remitted levies along the route in Zhili and Fengtian. Four hundred thousand shi from Tong granary were sent to drought-stricken Zhili. On renchen day, drought taxes were remitted in sixteen Shandong districts including Licheng. On yiwei day, this year's judicial review executions were halted. The court stopped at the Summer Resort with the Empress Dowager. On bingshen day, taxes on flood-washed Fujian land including Lianjiang were removed. On jihai day, the Emperor and Empress Dowager went on to Mukden. On guimao day, the Emperor hunted at Yong'anmangka. On yisi day, the Emperor hunted at Aili. On bingwu day, the Emperor hunted at Xilanuohai. District abuses in grain-transport warehouse surcharges were ordered ended. On wushen day, hail-struck Cangzhou saltern quotas were remitted. The court halted at Mamatala with the Empress Dowager. From jiyou through jimao the Emperor hunted each day. Governors were strictly forbidden to leak confidential memorials. Three Hubei districts including Xingguo received flood relief and tax remission. On guihai day, the Longevity Festival, the Emperor performed rites at the Empress Dowager's tent. At the tent, princes, ministers, and Mongol nobles offered congratulations. Banquets were given to princes, ministers, and Mongol nobles. On jiazi day, the court halted at Bayarettatala. On yichou day, the Emperor hunted. On wuchen day, the Emperor hunted. From renshen through bingzi the Emperor halted at Yikenuo'er and hunted. On jiaxu day, Xichang received flood relief. Zhili drought relief rules were set. Sixteen Guangdong districts including Shixing received flood relief. On jimao day, the Emperor killed a tiger with his own bow at Bayan.
98
九月庚辰朔，上行圍於伍什杭阿，親射殪虎。 辛巳，上行圍威准。 壬午，上行圍黃科。 癸未，上行圍阿蘭。 以哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖未奏往額爾德尼招禮拜，土謝圖汗敦丹多爾濟均下理籓院議處。 甲申，賑陝西商州水災飢。 乙酉，上行圍舍里。 丙戌，上行圍善顏倭赫。 丁亥，上行圍巴彥。 鄂彌達改荊州將軍。 調博第為吉林將軍，富森為黑龍江將軍。 戊子，上行圍尼雅滿珠。 己丑，上行圍珠敦。 庚寅，上行圍英額邊門外。 是日，駐蹕烏蘇河。 甲午，許容以劾謝濟世貪縱各款皆虛，孫嘉淦以扶同定案，均褫職。 署糧道倉德以通揭鞫實，予敘。 上駐蹕穆奇村。 乙未，上奉皇太后謁永陵。 丙申，行大饗禮。 命停顧琮議限民田。 賑河南祥符等二十一州縣、山東齊東等十八州縣衛旱災，並免額賦有差。 辛丑，謁福陵。 壬寅，行大饗禮。 謁昭陵。 癸卯，行大饗禮。 上奉皇太后駐蹕盛京。 朝鮮國王李昑遣陪臣至盛京貢方物。 甲辰，上率群臣詣皇太后宮行慶賀禮。 御崇政殿受賀。 賜群臣及朝鮮使臣宴。 御大政殿賜酺。 頒詔覃恩有差。 乙巳，上詣文廟釋奠。 幸講武臺大閱。 諭王公宗室大臣等潔蠲禮典，訓導兵民，毋忘淳樸舊俗。 丙午，上親奠克勤郡王岳託及武勛王揚古利墓。 遣官望祭長白山、北鎮醫巫閭山及遼太祖陵。 戊申，上親奠弘毅公額宜都、直義公費英東墓。 免河南帶徵乾隆七年以前民欠。
In the ninth month, the Emperor killed a tiger at Wushihenga. On xinsi day, the Emperor hunted at Weizhun. On renwu day, the Emperor hunted at Huangke. On guiwei day, the Emperor hunted at Alan. The Jebzundamba Khutukhtu and Tusheet Khan Dundendorji were sent to the Court of Colonial Affairs for failing to report a pilgrimage to Erdene Juu. On jiashen day, Shangzhou received flood and famine relief. On yiyou day, the Emperor hunted at Sheli. On bingxu day, the Emperor hunted at Shanyanwohe. On dinghai day, the Emperor hunted at Bayan. E'mida became Jingzhou general. Bodi went to Jilin and Fusen to Heilongjiang as generals. On wuzi day, the Emperor hunted at Niyamanzhu. On jichou day, the Emperor hunted at Zhudun. On gengyin day, the Emperor hunted outside Ying'e Pass. The court halted that day at the Usu River. Xu Rong and Sun Jiagan were dismissed over the false impeachment of Xie Jishi. Cang De was rewarded after a public denunciation proved true. The court halted at Muqi Village. On yiwei day, the Emperor with the Empress Dowager visited Yong Mausoleum. On bingshen day, the great feast offering was made. Gu Cong's plan to cap private land was stopped. Henan and Shandong drought districts were relieved and taxes remitted. On xinchou day, the Emperor visited Fuling. On renyin day, the great feast offering was made. The Emperor visited Zhaoling. On guimao day, the great feast offering was made. The court with the Empress Dowager halted at Shengjing. Korean King Li Yin sent tribute to Shengjing. On jiachen day, officials congratulated the Empress Dowager. Congratulations were received at Chongzheng Hall. Officials and the Korean envoy were banqueted. A court libation was granted at Dazheng Hall. An edict granted grace in varying degrees. On bingwu day, the Emperor sacrificed at the Confucian temple. A grand martial review was held at the Parade Ground. Princes and ministers were urged to preserve simple Manchu customs. On dingwei day, the Emperor sacrificed at Yuetuo's and Yangguli's tombs. Envoys offered distant sacrifice at Changbai, Yiwulü, and the Liao founder's tomb. On wushen day, the Emperor sacrificed at E'iyetu's and Fei Yingdong's tombs. Henan's supplementary levy arrears before year 7 were remitted.
99
冬十月庚戌朔，上御大政殿，賜扈從王大臣宴於鳳凰樓前。 諭王公宗室等革除陋習，恪守舊章。 免盛京、興京等十五處旗地本年額賦及乾隆七年逋賦。 御制盛京賦。 辛亥，上奉皇太后回蹕。 乙丑，賑廣東南海等七縣水災。 是日，上登望海樓，駐文殊菴。 丁卯，命直隸被災各屬減價平糶。 己巳，命部院大臣京察各舉賢自代。 以劉於義為戶部尚書，阿里袞為山西巡撫。 命徐本仍兼管戶部。 調陳宏謀為陝西巡撫，塞楞額為江西巡撫。 庚午，賑河南祥符等十四州縣旱災。 甲戌，上奉皇太后還京師。 丁丑，上以謁陵禮成，率群臣詣皇太后宮行慶賀禮。 御太和殿，王大臣各官進表朝賀。
On the first of the tenth month, the Emperor banqueted the entourage at Dazheng Hall. Princes were told to end bad habits and follow old rules. Shengjing-area banner land tax for the year and year-7 arrears were remitted. The Emperor wrote the Rhapsody on Shengjing. On xinhai day, the court with the Empress Dowager set out for home. On yichou day, Guangdong flood districts were relieved. The Emperor climbed Wanghai Tower and halted at Wenshu Nunnery. On dingmao day, Zhili disaster areas got subsidized grain sales. On jisi day, capital ministers were to nominate successors in their evaluations. Liu Yuyi became Revenue minister and Aligun Shanxi governor. Xu Ben kept concurrent charge of Revenue. Chen Hongmou went to Shaanxi and Saileng'e to Jiangxi. On gengwu day, Henan drought areas were relieved. On jiaxu day, the court with the Empress Dowager reached Beijing. On dingchou day, officials congratulated the Empress Dowager after the tomb tour. Felicitation was held at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
100
十一月，賑安徽無為水災，並免額賦。 壬午，賑甘肅狄道等二十四州縣水蟲風雹災。 庚寅，安南國王黎維禕表謝賜祭及襲封恩，進貢方物。 辛丑，賑廣東萬州等十四州縣水災，福建臺灣等三縣旱災。 壬寅，貸黑龍江被旱被霜兵丁等倉糧。 賑山西曲沃等十一州旱災。 癸卯，賑直隸天津等二縣旱災。 丁未，賑安徽壽州等九州縣衛旱災。 己酉，免謁陵經過額賦十分之三。
In the eleventh month, Wuwei flood victims were relieved and taxes remitted. On renwu day, twenty-four Gansu districts got disaster relief. On gengyin day, Annam's Le Duy Yi thanked the court and sent tribute. On xinchou day, Guangdong floods and Fujian Taiwan drought were relieved. On renyin day, Heilongjiang troops got lent grain after drought and frost. Shanxi drought districts were relieved. On guimao day, Tianjin-area drought was relieved. On dingwei day, Anhui drought areas were relieved. On jiyou day, one-tenth of transit land tax was remitted.
101
十二月庚戌朔，賑廣東吳川縣旱災。 辛亥，命史貽直協辦大學士。 乙卯，賑山東陵縣等十二州縣衛旱災。 葬端慧皇太子於朱華山寢園。 辛酉，大學士福敏乞退。 溫諭慰留。 甲子，準噶爾遣貢使圖爾都等至京，謝進藏人由噶斯路行走，賜助牲畜恩，並貢方物。 乙丑，以陳德華隱匿其弟陝西按察使陳德正申辨參案密奏，下部嚴議。 德正褫職鞫治。 丁卯，以星變示儆，詔修省。
On the first of the twelfth month, Wuchuan drought was relieved. On xinhai day, Shi Yizhi was made assisting Grand Secretary. On yimao day, Shandong drought districts were relieved. Crown Prince Duanhui was buried at Zhuhua Mountain. On xinyou day, Grand Secretary Fumin sought retirement. A warm edict kept him at post. On jiazi day, Dzungar envoys thanked aid for the Tibet route and brought tribute. On yichou day, Chen Dehua was severely investigated for hiding his brother's petition. Chen Dezheng was dismissed and tried. On dingmao day, a stellar omen prompted an austerity edict.
102
九年春正月辛巳，以徐本病，命史貽直為大學士。 以劉於義為吏部尚書、協辦大學士，張楷為戶部尚書。 陳德華罷，以王安國為兵部尚書。 壬午，幸瀛臺。 御大幄次，賜準噶爾使圖爾都宴，命立首班大臣末。 以噶爾丹策零恭順，圖爾都誠敬可嘉，召圖爾都近前，賜飲三爵，錫賚有加。 訓飭各省州縣教養兼施。 丁亥，賑直隸天津等十一州縣災。 庚子，王安國憂免，以彭維新為兵部尚書。 以許容署湖北巡撫。 授史貽直文淵閣大學士。 朝鮮入貢。 給訥親欽差大臣關防。 癸卯，上奉皇太后詣泰陵。 丙午，上詣泰陵。 是日，奉皇太后回蹕。
In the first month of year 9, Shi Yizhi became Grand Secretary as Xu Ben fell ill. Liu Yuyi became Personnel minister and assisting secretary; Zhang Kai, Revenue minister. Chen Dehua was removed; Wang Anguo became War minister. On renwu day, the Emperor visited Yingtai. Tudou was banqueted and seated last among first-rank ministers. Tudou was summoned, given three cups, and richly rewarded for Dzungar sincerity. Officials were told to combine nurture and instruction. On dinghai day, Tianjin-area disasters were relieved. On gengzi day, Wang Anguo left for mourning and Peng Weixin became War minister. Xu Rong became acting Hubei governor. Shi Yizhi became Wenyuan Hall Grand Secretary. Korea sent tribute. Neqin received an imperial commissioner seal. On guimao day, the Emperor with the Empress Dowager went to Tai Mausoleum. On bingwu day, the Emperor visited Tai Mausoleum. The Empress Dowager returned with the court that day.
103
二月，上奉皇太后幸南苑。 丙辰，以給事中陳大玠等奏，寢許容署湖北巡撫之命，留晏斯盛任，仍申誡言官扶同糾論。 免安徽桐城等九州縣上年水災額賦。 免福建臺灣等三縣旱災額賦，並賑之。 甲子，陳德華降調。 丁卯，賑雲南霑、益二州縣水災。 丁丑，戶部尚書張楷卒，以阿爾賽代之，鄂彌達為湖廣總督。
In the second month, the court with the Empress Dowager went to the Southern Park. On bingchen day, Xu Rong's Hubei appointment was halted and censors warned anew. Anhui flood districts' last-year tax was remitted. Fujian Taiwan drought tax was remitted and victims relieved. On jiazi day, Chen Dehua was demoted. On dingmao day, Yunnan flood districts were relieved. On dingchou day, Zhang Kai died; A'ersai succeeded him and E'mida became Huguang governor-general.
104
三月癸未，以汪由敦為工部尚書。 丁亥，免江蘇沛縣、河南中牟等六縣旱災額賦。 丁酉，調博第為西安將軍。 以巴靈阿為寧古塔將軍。 乙巳，賑山東德州等五州縣衛旱災。 以訥親奏查閱河南、江南營伍廢弛，上曰：「可見外省大吏無一不欺朕者，不可不懲一儆百。 」
In the third month, on guawei day, Wang Youdun became Works minister. On dinghai day, Jiangsu and Henan drought tax was remitted. On dingyou day, Bodi became Xi'an general. Baling'a became Ningguta general. On bingwu day, Shandong drought areas were relieved. When Neqin reported Henan and Jiangnan troops neglected, the Emperor demanded punishing one grandee to warn the rest. The edict continued.
105
四月戊申朔，始建先蠶壇成。 乙卯，上詣圜丘行大雩禮，特詔貶損儀節，以示虔禱。 以旱命省刑寬禁。 辛未，賑山東德平等八州縣旱災。 己卯，諭曰：「一春以來，雨澤稀少。 皇太后以天時久旱，憂形於色，今日從寢宮步行至園內龍神廟虔禱。 朕惶恐戰慄，即刻前往請安，諄懇謝罪，特諭內外臣工知之。 」戊子，祭地於方澤，不乘輦，不設鹵簿。 庚寅，雨。 壬寅，大學士、九卿議覆御史柴潮生請修直隸水利，命協辦大學士劉於義往保定會同高斌籌畫。
On the first of the fourth month, the First Silkworm altar was completed. On yimao day, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Circular Mound with simplified rites. Drought prompted orders to lighten penalties and relax bans. On xinwei day, Shandong's Deping and seven other counties received drought relief. On jimao day, an edict said spring rains had been scarce. The Empress Dowager, troubled by prolonged drought, walked from her palace to the garden Dragon God Temple to pray. The Emperor went at once to pay respects, apologized earnestly, and instructed all officials. On wuzi day, earth sacrifice at Fangze was performed without palanquin or guard of honor. On gengyin day, rain fell. On renyin day, officials replied on Zhili water works; Liu Yuyi was sent to Baoding with Gao Bin to plan.
106
六月己酉，大學士徐本以病乞休，允之。 癸丑，賑山東歷城等三十二州縣旱災，蘭山等六州縣雹災。
In the sixth month, Xu Ben retired ill and was allowed to leave. On guichou day, Shandong drought and hail disasters in Lanshan and elsewhere were relieved.
107
秋七月丙子朔，諭直隸災重之天津等十六州縣，本年停徵新舊錢糧。 丙戌，免江蘇、安徽雍正十三年逋賦。 壬辰，額爾圖以不職免，以達勒黨阿為奉天將軍。
In the seventh month, sixteen hard-hit Zhili districts were told to stop tax and grain levies for the year. On bingxu day, Jiangsu and Anhui's Yongzheng-era tax arrears were remitted. On renchen day, E'ertu was dismissed and Daledang'a became Fengtian general.
108
八月己酉，撫恤安徽歙縣等二十州縣水災。 戊申，免江蘇淮安、安徽鳳陽二府雍正十三年逋賦。 癸丑，賑四川成都等州縣水災。 乙丑，予告大學士徐本回籍，上賜詩寵行，賞賚有加，並諭行幸南苑之日，親臨慰問。 丙寅，免直隸天津等三十一州縣上年逋賦。 己巳，上奉皇太后幸南苑，上行圍。
In the eighth month, flood victims in twenty Anhui districts were consoled. On wushen day, Huai'an and Fengyang's Yongzheng tax arrears were remitted. On guichou day, Sichuan flood districts including Chengdu were relieved. On yichou day, Xu Ben went home with imperial poetry and gifts; the Emperor would visit him when touring the Southern Park. On bingyin day, tax arrears were remitted in thirty-one Zhili districts including Tianjin. On jisi day, the Emperor took the Empress Dowager to the Southern Park and hunted.
109
九月己亥朔，以翰林院編修黃體明進呈講章，牽及搜檢太嚴，隱含諷刺，下部嚴議褫職。 乙未，免山西清水河本年雹災額賦。 癸卯，賑山東博興等縣旱災。 丁未，改明年會試於三月舉行。 己酉，以陳世倌假滿，命入閣辦事。 賑山西文水等縣水災。 庚戌，以四川學政蔣蔚實心教士，命留任。 乙卯，上奉皇太后幸湯山。 江南、河南、山東蝗。 癸亥，上幸盤山。 丁卯，上奉皇太后還宮。 庚午，重修翰林院工竣。 上幸翰林院賜宴，分韻賦詩，復御制柏梁體詩首句，群臣以次賡續。 賜掌院大學士鄂爾泰、張廷玉御書扁額，及翰林、詹事諸臣書幣有差。 是日，幸貢院，賜御書聯額。 復幸紫微殿、觀象臺。 賑直隸保定等十八州縣水蟲雹等災。 賑江蘇靖江等十二州縣衛潮災，安徽歙縣二十一州縣衛水災。 庚辰，起孫嘉淦為宗人府府丞。 辛巳，除直隸涿州等三州縣水沖地賦。 丙戌，山東登州鎮總兵馬世龍以科派兵丁，鞫實論絞。 賑甘肅河州等三十五州縣衛雹水各災。 辛卯，以江西學政金德瑛取士公明，命留任。 己亥，以貴州學政佟保守潔士服，命留任。 丙午，鄂爾泰議覆劉於義奏勘直隸水利，命撥銀五十萬兩興修。 丁未，免浙江仁和等三十一州縣所旱災額賦，並賑之。 辛亥，賑成都等三十州縣水災。 壬子，允準噶爾貢使哈柳等隨帶牛羊等物在肅州貿易。 甲子，免山東歷城等三十二州縣衛本年旱雹等災額賦。 乙丑，免直隸保定等十一州縣廳本年水旱蟲雹災額賦。 丙寅，賞雷鋐額外諭德，食俸。 戊辰，張照丁憂，調汪由敦為刑部尚書，以趙弘恩為工部尚書。 免安徽歙縣等二十一州縣衛水災額賦。 辛未，以福建閩縣等縣火災，諭責疆吏不嚴火備。 羅卜藏丹怎就獲。
In the ninth month, Huang Timing was dismissed after a lecture chapter satirized strict searches. On yiwei day, Shanxi hail-damaged districts' taxes were remitted. On guimao day, Shandong drought counties including Boxing were relieved. On dingwei day, the next metropolitan exam was set for the third month. On jiyou day, Chen Shiguan returned from leave to serve in the Grand Secretariat. Shanxi flood districts including Wenshui were relieved. On gengxu day, Jiang Wei was kept as Sichuan education intendant for devoted teaching. On yimao day, the Emperor took the Empress Dowager to Tangshan. Locusts plagued Jiangnan, Henan, and Shandong. On guihai day, the Emperor visited Panshan. On dingmao day, the Emperor and Empress Dowager returned to the palace. On gengwu day, Hanlin Academy reconstruction was finished. At the Hanlin banquet the Emperor set rhymes and the opening Bo Liang verse for ministers to continue. Ortai and Zhang Tingyu received imperial inscribed plaques; other officials received graded gifts. That day the Emperor visited the exam compound and gave inscribed scrolls. He also visited Ziwei Hall and the Observatory. Eighteen Zhili districts including Baoding received disaster relief. Jiangsu tidal and Anhui flood districts were relieved. On gengchen day, Sun Jiagan became Imperial Clan Court vice director. On xinsi day, tax on flood-washed Zhili land was remitted. On bingxu day, Ma Shilong was sentenced to death for extorting his troops. Thirty-five Gansu districts received hail and flood relief. On xinmao day, Jin Deying was kept for fair Jiangxi examinations. On jihai day, Tong Bao was kept for upright conduct as Guizhou education intendant. On bingwu day, five hundred thousand taels were allocated for Zhili water works. On dingwei day, Zhejiang drought taxes were remitted and relief distributed. On xinhai day, thirty Sichuan districts including Chengdu received flood relief. On renzi day, Dzungar envoys were allowed to trade livestock at Suzhou. On jiazi day, Shandong disaster taxes in thirty-two districts were remitted. On yichou day, eleven Zhili districts' disaster taxes were remitted. On bingyin day, Lei Chuo received Exhortation Tutor rank and salary. On wuchen day, Zhang Zhao mourned; Wang Youdun and Zhao Hong'en received ministerial posts. Anhui flood taxes in twenty-one districts were remitted. On xinwei day, Fujian officials were rebuked over fire in Minxian and elsewhere. Luobuzangdanjin was taken prisoner.
110
十年春正月丙子，召大學士、內廷翰林於重華宮聯句。 改會試於三月，著為令。 乙未，大學士鄂爾泰以病乞解任，溫諭慰留。 己亥，準噶爾遣使哈柳貢方物。 庚子，召高斌來京，以劉於義署直隸總督。 己酉，賑浙江淳安等四縣上年水災。 朝鮮入貢。 辛亥，上幸內右門直廬視鄂爾泰疾。 己未，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵。 庚申，免廣東海陽等二縣上年水災額賦。 甲子，免江蘇丹徒等十州縣衛上年水災額賦。 丁卯，上還京師。 己巳，免山東博興等二縣乾隆九年旱災額賦。 庚午，高斌回直隸總督。
In the tenth year, first month, Grand Secretaries and Hanlin composed coupled verses at Chonghua Palace. The metropolitan exam was permanently set for the third month. On yiwei day, Ortai's resignation for illness was refused with comforting words. On jihai day, Dzungar envoy Haliu brought tribute. On gengzi day, Gao Bin was recalled and Liu Yuyi acted Zhili governor-general. On jiyou day, four Zhejiang counties received flood relief. Korea presented tribute. On xinhai day, the Emperor visited the ailing Ortai. On jiwei day, the Emperor visited the imperial mausoleums. On gengshen day, Guangdong flood taxes were remitted. On jiazi day, Jiangsu flood taxes in ten districts were remitted. On dingmao day, the Emperor returned to Beijing. On jisi day, Shandong drought taxes from the ninth year were remitted. On gengwu day, Gao Bin returned as Zhili governor-general.
111
三月癸酉朔，日食。 乙亥，改殿試於四月，著為令。 賑雲南白鹽井水災。 庚辰，上幸鄂爾泰第視疾。 辛巳，加鄂爾泰太傅。 己丑，協辦大學士、禮部尚書三泰乞休，允之。 庚寅，命訥親協辦大學士，調來保為禮部尚書，以盛安為刑部尚書。 癸巳，免浙江仁和等三十州縣上年旱災額賦。 甲午，以安南莫康武作亂，攻陷太原、高平等處，命那蘇圖等嚴防邊隘。 乙未，加史貽直、陳世倌、來保、高斌太子太保，劉於義、張允隨、張廣泗太子少保。
In the third month, a solar eclipse occurred. On yihai day, the palace exam was permanently set for the fourth month. Yunnan's Baiyanjing received flood relief. On gengchen day, the Emperor called on the ailing Ortai at home. On xinsi day, Ortai was made Grand Tutor. On jichou day, San Tai retired and was allowed to leave. On gengyin day, Neqin assisted the Grand Secretariat; Laibao and Sheng'an received posts. On guisi day, Zhejiang drought taxes were remitted. On jiawu day, officials were ordered to guard the border after Mo Kangwu seized Annamese towns. On yiwei day, several ministers received heir-apparent tutor ranks.
112
夏四月癸卯朔，發江南帑銀五十六萬兩濬河道。 己巳，免山東海豐等二縣被旱額徵灶課。 乙卯，大學士鄂爾泰卒，上臨奠，輟朝二日，命遵世宗遺詔，配饗太廟。 召那蘇圖來京，以策楞為兩廣總督。 調準泰為廣東巡撫。 以魏定國為安徽巡撫。 庚申，召蔣溥來京，以楊錫紱為湖南巡撫。 壬戌，飭沿海各省訓練水師。 癸亥，以旱命刑部清理庶獄。 戊辰，策試貢士，詔能深悉時政直言極諫者聽。 己巳，慶復、紀山奏進剿瞻對番。
In the fourth month, 560,000 taels were sent from Jiangnan to dredge rivers. On jisi day, Shandong salt-field drought taxes were remitted. On yimao day, Ortai died; the Emperor mourned, halted court, and ordered him enshrined in the Grand Temple. Nasutu was recalled; Celeng became Liangguang governor-general. Zhuntai became Guangdong governor. Wei Dingguo became Anhui governor. On gengshen day, Jiang Pu was recalled and Yang Xifu became Hunan governor. On renxu day, coastal provinces were told to train their fleets. On guihai day, drought prompted orders to clear routine cases in prison. On wuchen day, presented scholars were examined; frank remonstrance on policy was welcomed. On jisi day, Qing Fu and Ji Shan reported advancing against Dondup tribes.
113
五月壬申朔，賜錢維城等三百三十三人進士及第出身有差。 丁亥，除江蘇蘇州等九府坍沒蘆課。 頒御制太學訓飭士子文於各省學宮，同世祖臥碑文、聖祖聖諭廣訓、世宗朋黨論朔望宣講。 命訥親為保和殿大學士。 辛卯，戶部尚書阿爾賽為家奴所害，磔家奴於市。 以高斌為吏部尚書，那蘇圖為直隸總督。 命高斌、劉於義仍辦直隸水利河道。 以梁詩正為戶部尚書。 己亥，命劉於義兼管戶部事務。
In the fifth month, 333 graduates including Qian Weicheng received doctoral degrees. On dinghai day, Jiangsu reed taxes on lost land were remitted. An imperial essay on scholars was sent to provincial schools for monthly lectures with earlier dynastic texts. Neqin became Grand Secretary of the Hall of Preserving Harmony. On xinmao day, Revenue Minister Arsai was killed by a slave who was executed by dismemberment. Gao Bin became Personnel Minister and Nasutu Zhili governor-general. Gao Bin and Liu Yuyi remained in charge of Zhili waterways. Liang Shizheng became Minister of Revenue. On jihai day, Liu Yuyi was also placed over Revenue Ministry business.
114
六月丁未，普免全國錢糧。 諭曰：「朕臨御天下，十年於茲。 撫育蒸黎，躬行儉約，薄賦輕徭，孜孜保治，不敢稍有暇逸。 今寰宇敉寧，左藏有餘，持盈保泰，莫先足民。 天下之財，止有此數，不聚於上，即散於下。 我皇祖在位六十一年，蠲租賜復之詔，史不絕書，普免天下錢糧一次。 我皇考無日不下減賦寬征之令，如甘肅一省，正賦全行豁免者十有餘年。 朕以繼志述事之心，際重熙累洽之後，欲使海澨山陬，俱沾大澤，為是特頒諭旨，丙寅年直省應徵錢糧，其通蠲之。 」庚戌，免安徽鳳陽等州府連年被災地方耗羨。 命戶部侍郎傅恆在軍機處行走。 辛酉，御史赫泰請收回普免錢糧成命。 上斥其悖謬，褫職。 癸亥，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。
In the sixth month, taxes and grain were remitted empire-wide. An edict said the Emperor had ruled ten years. I cherish the people, live frugally, keep taxes and labor light, and govern diligently without rest. The empire is at peace and the treasury full; enriching the people is the first duty of lasting rule. The empire's wealth is finite: what is not kept at court flows to the people. My grandfather's sixty-one-year reign was filled with rent remissions and relief; once he remitted all land-tax grain empire-wide. My father issued tax-relief orders daily; Gansu's main levies were fully exempt for over ten years. Wishing every shore and valley to share bounty after long peace, I ordered all land-tax grain due from the provinces in the bingyin year wholly remitted. The edict closed. On gengxu day, disaster surcharges were remitted in Fengyang and other Anhui prefectures. Fu Heng was assigned to the Grand Council. On xinyou day, Censor He Tai asked to revoke the universal tax remission. The Emperor called him perverse and dismissed him. On guihai day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.
115
秋七月辛未朔，免甘肅寧夏等三縣逋賦。 癸酉，以順直宛平等六十四廳州縣缺雨，命停徵錢糧。 乙酉，命高斌仍兼直隸河道總督。 戊子，賑安徽壽州等十八州縣衛水災雹災。 壬辰，上奉皇太后幸多倫諾爾，免經過州縣額賦十分之四。 戊戌，上奉皇太后駐避暑山莊。 賑安徽宿州等州縣衛水災。
Seventh month, xinwei new moon: Gansu arrears were remitted for Ningxia and two other counties. On guiyou day, tax collection was halted in sixty-four rain-starved Zhili districts including Wanping. On yiyou day, Gao Bin again held the Zhili river director-generalship. On wuzi day, flood and hail relief went to eighteen Anhui jurisdictions including Shouzhou. On renchen day, traveling with the Empress Dowager to Duolun, the Emperor cut passing counties' quota tax by four-tenths. On wuxu day, the court halted at the Summer Mountain Resort. Flood relief was sent to Suzhou and other Anhui prefectures and counties.
116
八月癸卯，賑兩淮莞瀆等三場水災。 停徵湖北漢川等十七州縣水災、光化等二縣雹災額賦，並賑之。 上奉皇太后幸木蘭行圍。 甲辰，上駐波羅河屯。 賜青海蒙古王公宴，並賚之。 丁未，上行圍永安莽喀。 戊申，上行圍畢雅喀拉。 己酉，上行圍溫都里華。 辛亥，上行圍額爾袞郭。 賜蒙古王、額駙、台吉等宴。 癸丑，上行圍布爾噶蘇台。 甲寅，上行圍巴彥溝。 乙卯，上行圍烏里雅蘇台。 賜王、大臣、蒙古王、額駙、台吉等宴。 丙辰，上行圍畢圖舍爾。 賑直隸宣化府屬旱災。 丁巳，上行圍阿濟格鳩和洛。 戊午，上行圍僧機圖。 己未，上行圍永安湃。 庚申，上行圍英圖和洛。 辛酉，上行圍薩達克圖口。 壬戌，賑湖北宜城等三州縣衛水災。 癸亥，上行圍老圖博勒齊爾。 乙丑，上行圍庫爾奇勒。 丙寅，賑甘肅安定等三縣、廣東電白等二縣旱災，海豐蟲災，南澳風災。 上駐多倫諾爾。 丁卯，賜王、大臣、蒙古王、額駙、台吉等宴。 賑山西曲沃等十二州縣水災。
Eighth month, guimao day: flood relief went to three Liang-Huai salt-fields including Guandu. Quota tax was halted and relief given for Hubei floods and hail in Guanghua and one other county. The Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to the Mulan hunt. On jiachen day, the Emperor halted at Boluohetun. Qinghai Mongol princes were feasted and rewarded. On dingwei day, the Emperor hunted at Yong'an Mangka. On wushen day, the Emperor hunted at Biya Kala. On jiyou day, the Emperor hunted at Wenduli Hua. On xinhai day, the Emperor hunted at E'ergun Guo. Mongol kings, imperial sons-in-law, and taiji were feasted. On guichou day, the Emperor hunted at Bu'erge Su Tai. On jiayin day, the Emperor hunted at Bayan Gou. On yimao day, the Emperor hunted at Wuliyasutai. Princes, ministers, Mongol kings, sons-in-law, and taiji were feasted. On bingchen day, the Emperor hunted at Bitushe'er. Drought relief went to Xuanhua prefecture districts in Zhili. On dingsi day, the Emperor hunted at Aji Geju Heluo. On wuwu day, the Emperor hunted at Sengji Tu. On jiwei day, the Emperor hunted at Yong'an Pai. On gengshen day, the Emperor hunted at Yingtu Heluo. On xinyou day, the Emperor hunted at Sadaketu Pass. On renxu day, flood relief went to Yicheng and two other Hubei jurisdictions. On guihai day, the Emperor hunted at Laotu Bo'erqi'er. On yichou day, the Emperor hunted at Ku'erqi'le. On bingyin day, drought relief went to Gansu and Guangdong counties; Haifeng received insect relief and Nan'ao wind relief. The Emperor halted at Duolun. On dingmao day, princes, ministers, and Mongol nobles were feasted. Flood relief went to Quwo and eleven other Shanxi counties.
117
九月庚午朔，上行圍額爾托昂色欽。 辛未，上行圍多倫鄂博圖。 壬申，遣祭明陵。 上行圍古哲諾爾。 癸酉，張允隨以猛緬土司奉廷徵等通緬莽，請改土歸流，命詳議。 上行圍塔奔陀羅海。 乙亥，賑河南永城等五縣水災。 上行圍札瑪克圖。 丙子，上行圍峞爾呼。 丁丑，賑直隸故城等十五州縣衛旱災。 癸未，上駐宣化府。 甲申，上閱宣化鎮兵。 丁亥，賑山東濟寧等六州縣衛水災，海豐旱災。 癸巳，上奉皇太后還京師。 甲午，授鄂彌達湖廣總督。 賑兩淮廟灣場水災。 丁酉，以普免錢糧，命查各省歷年存餘銀，以抵歲需。 戊戌，授尹繼善兩江總督。 命修明愍帝陵。 賑江蘇淮、徐、海被災州縣。 慶復奏收撫上瞻對，進剿下瞻對班滾，克加社丫等卡及南路各寨。 賑陝西長安等六縣水災。
Ninth month, gengwu new moon: the Emperor hunted at E'ertuoang Seqin. On xinwei day, the Emperor hunted at Duolun Ebo Tu. On renshen day, envoys sacrificed at the Ming tombs. The Emperor hunted at Guzhe Nuo'er. On guiyou day, Zhang Yunrui reported Burmese collusion by native chiefs and sought direct rule; the court ordered review. The Emperor hunted at Tabengtuoluo Hai. On yihai day, flood relief went to five Henan counties including Yongcheng. The Emperor hunted at Zhamake Tu. On bingzi day, the Emperor hunted at Wei'erhu. On dingchou day, drought relief went to fifteen Zhili jurisdictions including Gucheng. On guiwei day, the Emperor halted at Xuanhua. On jiashen day, the Emperor reviewed Xuanhua troops. On dinghai day, Shandong flood relief and Haifeng drought relief were ordered. On guisi day, the Emperor returned to Beijing with the Empress Dowager. On jiawu day, Eminida became Huguang governor-general. Flood relief went to the Miaowan salt-field. On dingyou day, provinces were told to use accumulated surpluses to cover needs after the universal remission. On wuxu day, Yin Jishan became Liangjiang governor-general. The court ordered repairs to the tomb of the Ming Min Emperor. Jiangsu's Huai, Xu, and Hai districts received disaster relief. Qing Fu reported pacifying upper Zhangdui, attacking Banben in lower Zhangdui, and capturing Kasheya and southern stockades. Flood relief went to six Shaanxi counties including Chang'an.
118
冬十月丁未，以甘肅甘山道歸併肅州道。 戊申，賑河南商丘等五縣水災。 辛亥，裁通政使司漢右通政一。 丙辰，命塞陳家浦決口。 戊午，命四川嚴查嘓匪。 禮部尚書任蘭枝乞休，允之。 癸亥，免江蘇海州等七州縣漕糧。 甲子，給江南災民葺屋銀。 賑江蘇江浦等二十一州縣衛水災。 乙丑，賑湖南湘陰等三縣、湖北漢川等二十一州縣衛旱災。 丙寅，除湖北當陽等二縣衛水沖地賦。
Tenth month, dingwei day: Gansu's Ganshan circuit was merged into Suzhou circuit. On wushen day, flood relief went to five Henan counties including Shangqiu. On xinhai day, one Han vice transmission commissioner post was cut. On bingchen day, the Chenjiapu breach was ordered closed. On wuwu day, Sichuan was ordered to suppress bandits rigorously. Ren Lanzhi, Minister of Rites, retired on request. On guihai day, tribute grain was remitted in seven Jiangsu prefectures including Haizhou. On jiazi day, Jiangnan victims received silver to rebuild houses. Flood relief went to twenty-one Jiangsu jurisdictions including Jiangpu. On yichou day, drought relief went to Hunan and Hubei counties including Xiangyin and Hanchuan. On bingyin day, tax on flood-washed land was cancelled in Dangyang and one other Hubei jurisdiction.
119
十一月庚午，賑順直香河等四十八州廳縣旱災，陝西興平等六縣水災。 辛未，賑山東滕縣等七州縣衛水災。 壬申，以王安國為禮部尚書。 甲戌，賑兩淮廟灣等場水災。 乙亥，傅清奏準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零與阿卜都爾噶里木汗構兵。 丁丑，賑山西大同等十八州縣旱霜雹災。 湖北巡撫晏斯盛乞養，以開泰代之。 辛巳，賑廣西思恩等縣旱災。 壬午，準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策零卒。 命西北兩路籌備邊防。 乙酉，賑廣東海矬等四場風災。 戊子，免安徽宿州等五州縣水災地方漕糧。 庚寅，陳家浦決口合龍。 癸巳，賑直隸宣化府屬及慶雲縣旱災。
Eleventh month, gengwu day: Zhili drought and Shaanxi flood relief were ordered. On xinwei day, flood relief went to seven Shandong jurisdictions including Tengzhou. On renshen day, Wang Anguo became Minister of Rites. On jiaxu day, Liang-Huai salt-fields including Miaowan received flood relief. On yihai day, Fu Qing reported war between Galdan Tseren and Khan Abudurgami. On dingchou day, drought, frost, and hail relief went to eighteen Shanxi jurisdictions including Datong. Yan Sisheng left Hubei to nurse his parents; Kai Tai succeeded him. On xinsi day, drought relief went to Si'en and other Guangxi counties. On renwu day, Galdan Tseren died. The northwestern routes were told to ready frontier defenses. On yiyou day, four Guangdong salt-fields including Haichuo received wind relief. On wuzi day, tribute grain was remitted in five flooded Anhui prefectures including Suzhou. On gengyin day, the Chenjiapu breach was sealed. On guisi day, drought relief went to Xuanhua districts and Qingyun in Zhili.
120
十二月辛亥，大學士福敏乞休，優詔允之，加太傅。 壬子，命慶復為文華殿大學士，留川陝總督任。 命高斌協辦大學士。 賑陝西隴西等州縣旱災。 賑淮北板浦等場水災。 乙卯，命協辦大學士高斌、侍郎蔣溥均在軍機處行走。
Twelfth month, xinhai day: Fu Min retired with honors as Grand Tutor. On renzi day, Qing Fu became Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall while keeping the Sichuan-Shaanxi post. Gao Bin was made Associate Grand Secretary. Drought relief went to Longxi and other Shaanxi counties. Flood relief went to Banpu and other north-Huai salt-fields. On yimao day, Gao Bin and Jiang Pu joined the Grand Council.
